Figure 4 integrates interval-level links between ATAC, H3K27ac and H3K27me3. The final catalog contains 157,984 records including singletons and 92,568 linked records. Denominators are stated for each summary. Catalog construction, stage aggregation, ordinal encoding, full clustering routines and manual program definitions are included below.

The saved cluster-trajectory table below is a cluster-level diagnostic, not a newly calculated mean for every final program. Final program means are retained in the original vector plot checkpoint used by the display notebook. The source program label 2d corresponds to the label 3d in the manuscript artwork. The exact final network-view version is not established by the available inputs.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/common.R")
repo_dir <- REPO
if (!exists("params", inherits = FALSE)) params <- list()
if (is.null(params$run_integration)) params$run_integration <- FALSE
if (is.null(params$load_native_bundles)) params$load_native_bundles <- FALSE

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,

  error = FALSE)
```


## Construct the pairwise, three-way and singleton catalog

The original integration code below expands each master interval by ±2.5 kb, joins the three pairwise overlap tables, verifies the exact common intersection, removes three-way pairs from the pairwise sets and appends intervals absent from all overlaps as singletons. Original row indices are retained. Execution is sequential here to avoid changing the user's parallel-worker plan; the overlap calculations and joins are unchanged. The following clustering section loads the final saved catalog by default within its optional rerun branch, so a freshly constructed catalog must be compared with it before substitution.

```{r integration-build-catalog, eval=isTRUE(params$run_integration)}

# Data input

# Contains GENOA but not VISTA annotations yet
atac <- read.csv(file.path(REPO, "data", "upstream", "final_tables", "Supp_Table_1_ATAC_master.csv"))
ac <- read.csv(file.path(REPO, "data", "upstream", "final_tables", "Supp_Table_2_AC_master.csv"))
me3 <-  read.csv(file.path(REPO, "data", "upstream", "final_tables", "Supp_Table_3_ME3_master.csv"))



# Fixing capitalization/spelling issue
ac$Fine_clusters <- ifelse(ac$Fine_clusters == "Grey", "grey", ac$Fine_clusters)

unique(ac$Fine_clusters)
unique(atac$Fine_clusters)
unique(me3$Fine_clusters)

head(atac)
head(me3)
head(ac)


gc()


library(GenomicRanges)
library(dplyr)
library(furrr)

# --- Convert to GRanges (±2.5 kb buffer) ---
buffer <- 2500
gr <- list(
  ATAC = GRanges(seqnames = atac$seqnames,

                 ranges   = IRanges(start = atac$start - buffer,

                                    end   = atac$end + buffer),
                 Fine_cluster = atac$Fine_clusters),
  AC   = GRanges(seqnames = ac$seqnames,

                 ranges   = IRanges(start = ac$start - buffer,

                                    end   = ac$end + buffer),
                 Fine_cluster = ac$Fine_clusters),
  ME3  = GRanges(seqnames = me3$seqnames,

                 ranges   = IRanges(start = me3$start - buffer,

                                    end   = me3$end + buffer),
                 Fine_cluster = me3$Fine_clusters)
)



names(gr$ATAC) <- atac$ID
names(gr$AC)   <- ac$ID
names(gr$ME3)  <- me3$ID
gr <- lapply(gr, function(x) { x$width <- width(x); x })



# --- Pairwise overlaps ---
df_atac_ac  <- setNames(as.data.frame(findOverlaps(gr$ATAC, gr$AC)),
                        c("idx_atac", "idx_ac"))
df_ac_me3   <- setNames(as.data.frame(findOverlaps(gr$AC, gr$ME3)),
                        c("idx_ac", "idx_me3"))
df_atac_me3 <- setNames(as.data.frame(findOverlaps(gr$ATAC, gr$ME3)),
                        c("idx_atac", "idx_me3"))




# --- Three-way overlaps ---
three_way_df <- df_atac_ac %>%
  inner_join(df_ac_me3,  by = "idx_ac") %>%
  inner_join(df_atac_me3, by = c("idx_atac","idx_me3")) %>%
  mutate(
    Chromosome = as.character(seqnames(gr$ATAC)[idx_atac]),
    ATAC_FC    = gr$ATAC$Fine_cluster[idx_atac],
    AC_FC      = gr$AC$Fine_cluster[idx_ac],
    ME3_FC     = gr$ME3$Fine_cluster[idx_me3],
    ATAC_Start = start(gr$ATAC)[idx_atac],
    ATAC_End = end(gr$ATAC)[idx_atac],

    AC_Start   = start(gr$AC)[idx_ac],
    AC_End   = end(gr$AC)[idx_ac],

    ME3_Start  = start(gr$ME3)[idx_me3],
    ME3_End  = end(gr$ME3)[idx_me3]
  )

################################################################################

# --- Validate overlap widths (parallel) ---
# This step goes beyond 'findOverlaps()' and checks the *exact* base-pair
# intersection among ATAC, AC, and ME3 intervals.
# We also compute two useful metrics:
#   1) Overlap_width  = number of base pairs shared by all three regions
#   2) Overlap_all_three = TRUE/FALSE flag if they overlap at all
#   3) Overlap_range = span of the union of all three intervals
# These values help confirm that apparent three-way overlaps are biologically valid.

# Use parallel workers for speed
future::plan(future::sequential)

# Define a function that takes start and end coordinates of three intervals
# and computes the overlap width, overlap presence, and genomic span
compute_overlap <- function(s1, e1, s2, e2, s3, e3) {
  # Expand each interval into a sequence of base positions
  # (e.g., s1=100, e1=105 → seq(100,105) = 100,101,102,103,104,105)
  # Then find the base positions common to all three intervals
  common <- Reduce(intersect, list(seq(s1, e1), seq(s2, e2), seq(s3, e3)))

  # Return a list with:
  list(
    width = length(common),            # exact number of overlapping bases
    has   = length(common) > 0,        # TRUE if there is any overlap at all
    range = max(e1, e2, e3) - min(s1, s2, s3) + 1  # total span covered by union
  )
}

# Apply compute_overlap() in parallel across all rows of three_way_df
# Each row = one candidate 3-way overlap (ATAC, AC, ME3 interval triplet)
res <- future_pmap(
  list(
    three_way_df$ATAC_Start, three_way_df$ATAC_End,
    three_way_df$AC_Start,   three_way_df$AC_End,
    three_way_df$ME3_Start,  three_way_df$ME3_End
  ),
  compute_overlap
)

# Extract values from the result list into three new columns:
three_way_df$Overlap_width     <- sapply(res, `[[`, "width")  # number of bp shared
three_way_df$Overlap_all_three <- sapply(res, `[[`, "has")    # TRUE/FALSE overlap flag
three_way_df$Overlap_range     <- sapply(res, `[[`, "range")  # genomic span of union

# --- Output ---
# After this step, three_way_df contains:
#   - The original indices + Fine_clusters and coordinates
#   - Overlap_width: quantitative measure of overlap (bp)
#   - Overlap_all_three: logical, TRUE if overlap > 0
#   - Overlap_range: span from the leftmost start to rightmost end
# This ensures that only biologically meaningful three-way overlaps are kept.




library(purrr)
library(dplyr)

# --- Helper: Create unique keys for filtering ---
# Keys are "idxA|idxB" strings that uniquely identify a pair of intervals
make_key <- function(x, y) paste(x, y, sep = "|")

# --- Keys for three-way overlaps ---
# For each pair, create keys so we can exclude them from two-way overlaps
three_way_keys <- list(
  atac_ac  = make_key(three_way_df$idx_atac, three_way_df$idx_ac),
  atac_me3 = make_key(three_way_df$idx_atac, three_way_df$idx_me3),
  ac_me3   = make_key(three_way_df$idx_ac,   three_way_df$idx_me3)
)

# --- Overlap width helper (two-way version) ---
# Computes exact base-pair overlap between two intervals
compute_overlap_width <- function(start1, end1, start2, end2) {
  max(0, min(end1, end2) - max(start1, start2) + 1)
}

# --- Filtered ATAC–AC overlaps ---
two_way_atac_ac <- df_atac_ac %>%
  # exclude pairs already present in three-way overlaps
  filter(!make_key(idx_atac, idx_ac) %in% three_way_keys$atac_ac) %>%
  # make sure indices exist (safety check)
  filter(idx_atac <= length(gr$ATAC), idx_ac <= length(gr$AC)) %>%
  # add genomic coordinates and compute overlap width
  mutate(
    ATAC_Start = start(gr$ATAC)[idx_atac],
    ATAC_End   = end(gr$ATAC)[idx_atac],
    AC_Start   = start(gr$AC)[idx_ac],
    AC_End     = end(gr$AC)[idx_ac],
    Overlap_width = mapply(compute_overlap_width, ATAC_Start, ATAC_End, AC_Start, AC_End)
  ) %>%
  filter(Overlap_width > 0) %>%
  # annotate metadata
  mutate(
    overlap_type = "atac_ac",
    Chromosome   = as.character(seqnames(gr$ATAC)[idx_atac]),
    ATAC_FC      = gr$ATAC$Fine_cluster[idx_atac],
    AC_FC        = gr$AC$Fine_cluster[idx_ac],
    ATAC_Width   = gr$ATAC$width[idx_atac],
    AC_Width     = gr$AC$width[idx_ac]
  )

# --- Filtered ATAC–ME3 overlaps ---
two_way_atac_me3 <- df_atac_me3 %>%
  filter(!make_key(idx_atac, idx_me3) %in% three_way_keys$atac_me3) %>%
  filter(idx_atac <= length(gr$ATAC), idx_me3 <= length(gr$ME3)) %>%
  mutate(
    ATAC_Start = start(gr$ATAC)[idx_atac],
    ATAC_End   = end(gr$ATAC)[idx_atac],
    ME3_Start  = start(gr$ME3)[idx_me3],
    ME3_End    = end(gr$ME3)[idx_me3],
    Overlap_width = mapply(compute_overlap_width, ATAC_Start, ATAC_End, ME3_Start, ME3_End)
  ) %>%
  filter(Overlap_width > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_type = "atac_me3",
    Chromosome   = as.character(seqnames(gr$ATAC)[idx_atac]),
    ATAC_FC      = gr$ATAC$Fine_cluster[idx_atac],
    ME3_FC       = gr$ME3$Fine_cluster[idx_me3],
    ATAC_Width   = gr$ATAC$width[idx_atac],
    ME3_Width    = gr$ME3$width[idx_me3]
  )

# --- Filtered AC–ME3 overlaps ---
two_way_ac_me3 <- df_ac_me3 %>%
  filter(!make_key(idx_ac, idx_me3) %in% three_way_keys$ac_me3) %>%
  filter(idx_ac <= length(gr$AC), idx_me3 <= length(gr$ME3)) %>%
  mutate(
    AC_Start  = start(gr$AC)[idx_ac],
    AC_End    = end(gr$AC)[idx_ac],
    ME3_Start = start(gr$ME3)[idx_me3],
    ME3_End   = end(gr$ME3)[idx_me3],
    Overlap_width = mapply(compute_overlap_width, AC_Start, AC_End, ME3_Start, ME3_End)
  ) %>%
  filter(Overlap_width > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_type = "ac_me3",
    Chromosome   = as.character(seqnames(gr$AC)[idx_ac]),
    AC_FC        = gr$AC$Fine_cluster[idx_ac],
    ME3_FC       = gr$ME3$Fine_cluster[idx_me3],
    AC_Width     = gr$AC$width[idx_ac],
    ME3_Width    = gr$ME3$width[idx_me3]
  )

# --- Combine all two-way overlaps into one data frame ---
two_way_df <- bind_rows(two_way_atac_ac, two_way_atac_me3, two_way_ac_me3)



library(furrr)
library(future)

# --- Parallel setup ---
# Use all cores minus one for performance
future::plan(future::sequential)

# --- Flexible overlap function for two intervals ---
# Computes:
#   - width = number of base pairs in the intersection
#   - has_overlap = TRUE if overlap > 0
#   - range = span of the union of the two intervals
compute_two_way_overlap <- function(start1, end1, start2, end2) {
  common <- intersect(seq(start1, end1), seq(start2, end2))
  range  <- max(end1, end2) - min(start1, start2) + 1
  list(width = length(common),
    has_overlap = length(common) > 0,
    range = range)
}

# --- Prepare overlap inputs based on overlap type ---
# Each row in two_way_df is either ATAC–AC, ATAC–ME3, or AC–ME3
# We pass the correct start/end pairs to the overlap function
overlap_inputs <- pmap(
  two_way_df,
  function(overlap_type, ATAC_Start, ATAC_End, AC_Start, AC_End, ME3_Start, ME3_End, ...) {
    if (overlap_type == "atac_ac") {
      list(ATAC_Start, ATAC_End, AC_Start, AC_End)
    } else if (overlap_type == "atac_me3") {
      list(ATAC_Start, ATAC_End, ME3_Start, ME3_End)
    } else if (overlap_type == "ac_me3") {
      list(AC_Start, AC_End, ME3_Start, ME3_End)
    } else {
      list(NA, NA, NA, NA)
    }
  }
)

# --- Run overlap validation in parallel ---
overlap_results <- future_map(
  overlap_inputs,
  ~compute_two_way_overlap(.x[[1]], .x[[2]], .x[[3]], .x[[4]])
)

# --- Extract results back into two_way_df ---
two_way_df$Overlap_width   <- sapply(overlap_results, `[[`, "width")       # exact overlap bp
two_way_df$Overlap_all_two <- sapply(overlap_results, `[[`, "has_overlap") # TRUE/FALSE overlap
two_way_df$Overlap_range   <- sapply(overlap_results, `[[`, "range")       # span of union




head(three_way_df)

head(two_way_df)


dim(three_way_df)

dim(two_way_df)



# --- Harmonize and combine two-way and three-way overlaps ---

three_way_df_renamed <- three_way_df
if ("Overlap_all_three" %in% names(three_way_df_renamed)) {
  names(three_way_df_renamed)[names(three_way_df_renamed) == "Overlap_all_three"] <- "Overlap_check"
}
if (!"Overlap_check" %in% names(three_way_df_renamed)) {
  three_way_df_renamed$Overlap_check <- NA
}
three_way_df_renamed$overlap_type <- "three_way"

two_way_df_renamed <- two_way_df
if ("Overlap_all_two" %in% names(two_way_df_renamed)) {
  names(two_way_df_renamed)[names(two_way_df_renamed) == "Overlap_all_two"] <- "Overlap_check"
}
if (!"Overlap_check" %in% names(two_way_df_renamed)) {
  two_way_df_renamed$Overlap_check <- NA
}

# 2. Define schema
common_cols <- c(
  "idx_atac", "idx_ac", "idx_me3",
  "Chromosome",
  "ATAC_FC", "AC_FC", "ME3_FC",
  "ATAC_Start", "ATAC_End",
  "AC_Start", "AC_End",
  "ME3_Start", "ME3_End",
  "Overlap_width", "Overlap_check", "Overlap_range",
  "overlap_type",
  "ATAC_Width", "AC_Width", "ME3_Width"
)

# 3. Add missing columns
three_way_df_renamed[setdiff(common_cols, names(three_way_df_renamed))] <- NA
two_way_df_renamed[setdiff(common_cols, names(two_way_df_renamed))]     <- NA

# 4. Recompute widths
three_way_df_renamed <- three_way_df_renamed %>%
  mutate(
    ATAC_Width = ifelse(!is.na(ATAC_Start), ATAC_End - ATAC_Start + 1, NA),
    AC_Width   = ifelse(!is.na(AC_Start),   AC_End   - AC_Start   + 1, NA),
    ME3_Width  = ifelse(!is.na(ME3_Start),  ME3_End  - ME3_Start  + 1, NA)
  )

two_way_df_renamed <- two_way_df_renamed %>%
  mutate(
    ATAC_Width = ifelse(!is.na(ATAC_Start), ATAC_End - ATAC_Start + 1, ATAC_Width),
    AC_Width   = ifelse(!is.na(AC_Start),   AC_End   - AC_Start   + 1, AC_Width),
    ME3_Width  = ifelse(!is.na(ME3_Start),  ME3_End  - ME3_Start  + 1, ME3_Width)
  )

# 5. Reorder
three_way_df_renamed <- three_way_df_renamed %>% dplyr::select(all_of(common_cols))
two_way_df_renamed   <- two_way_df_renamed   %>% dplyr::select(all_of(common_cols))

# 6. Combine
all_overlaps <- bind_rows(three_way_df_renamed, two_way_df_renamed)


atac_singletons <- atac %>%
  transmute(
    idx_atac = row_number(),
    idx_ac = NA_integer_,
    idx_me3 = NA_integer_,
    Chromosome = seqnames,
    ATAC_FC = Fine_clusters,
    AC_FC = "NA_module",
    ME3_FC = "NA_module",
    ATAC_Start = start,
    ATAC_End = end,
    AC_Start = NA_integer_,
    AC_End = NA_integer_,
    ME3_Start = NA_integer_,
    ME3_End = NA_integer_,
    overlap_type = "atac_singleton"
  )

ac_singletons <- ac %>%
  transmute(
    idx_atac = NA_integer_,
    idx_ac = row_number(),
    idx_me3 = NA_integer_,
    Chromosome = seqnames,
    ATAC_FC = "NA_module",
    AC_FC = Fine_clusters,
    ME3_FC = "NA_module",
    ATAC_Start = NA_integer_,
    ATAC_End = NA_integer_,
    AC_Start = start,
    AC_End = end,
    ME3_Start = NA_integer_,
    ME3_End = NA_integer_,
    overlap_type = "ac_singleton"
  )

me3_singletons <- me3 %>%
  transmute(
    idx_atac = NA_integer_,
    idx_ac = NA_integer_,
    idx_me3 = row_number(),
    Chromosome = seqnames,
    ATAC_FC = "NA_module",
    AC_FC = "NA_module",
    ME3_FC = Fine_clusters,
    ATAC_Start = NA_integer_,
    ATAC_End = NA_integer_,
    AC_Start = NA_integer_,
    AC_End = NA_integer_,
    ME3_Start = start,

overlap_core <- all_overlaps %>%
  dplyr::select(idx_atac, idx_ac, idx_me3)

all_overlaps_total <- bind_rows(
  all_overlaps,
  anti_join(atac_singletons, overlap_core, by = "idx_atac"),
  anti_join(ac_singletons,  overlap_core, by = "idx_ac"),

)
```
