## Stage medians and ordinal encoding

The helper functions below are selected from the original integration branch. Medians are computed across samples within each developmental stage. ATAC and AC use the 5th-percentile zero cutoff; ME3 uses the 2nd percentile. Remaining values are quantile-binned into ten levels, with the original rank-binning fallback if tied quantile breaks collapse. These ordinal values are not raw CPM/FPKM or WGCNA inputs.

```{r integration-stage-encoding, eval=isTRUE(params$run_integration)}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(
  {
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
  }
)
# Recorded developmental-stage aggregation and ordinal encoder.
# Source: Kdm6b_ME3_AC_and_ATAC_big_picture_Fg.6_v4.Rmd.
construct_metadata <- function(df, modality) {
  # Pick suffix by modality
  suffix <- ifelse(modality == "ATAC", "_cpm$", "_fpkm$")

  # Extract sample names
  sample_names <- grep(
    suffix, names(df),
    value = TRUE
  )
  sample_clean <- gsub(suffix, "", sample_names)
  sample_clean <- gsub("^(Atac_|Hac_|Htk_)", "", sample_clean)  # strip prefixes

  metadata <- data.frame(
    RawName = sample_names,
    Samples = sample_clean,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Age: extract E## or P##
  metadata$age <- gsub(".*(E\\d+|P\\d+).*", "\\1", metadata$Samples)

  # Region: _C = Caudal, _R = Rostral
  metadata$region <- ifelse(
    grepl("_C", metadata$Samples),
    "Caudal", ifelse(
      grepl("_R", metadata$Samples),
      "Rostral", NA
    )
  )

  # Developmental compartment
  metadata$dev <- NA
  metadata$dev[grepl("Nex", metadata$Samples)] <- "Neurons"
  metadata$dev[grepl("Vz", metadata$Samples)] <- "VZ"
  metadata$dev[grepl("Svz", metadata$Samples)] <- "SVZ"
  metadata$dev[grepl("Ntsr", metadata$Samples)] <- "L6"
  metadata$dev[grepl("Rbp", metadata$Samples)] <- "L5"

  return(metadata)
}
# Usage
build_stage_matrix <- function(df, metadata, suffix) {

  value_cols <- grep(
    paste0(suffix, "$"),
    names(df),
    value = TRUE
  )

  df %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, all_of(value_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(value_cols),
      names_to = "RawName",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "RawName") %>%
    dplyr::filter(dev %in% c("VZ", "SVZ", "Neurons", "L6", "L5")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stage = dplyr::recode(
        dev,
        VZ = "VZ",
        SVZ = "SVZ",
        Neurons = "ImN",
        L6 = "L6N",

        L5 = "L5N"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ID, stage) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),


      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = stage,
      values_from = value) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ID)
}
ordinalize <- function(mat,
  stages,
  zero_q = 0.05,
  n_levels = 10,
  id_col = "ID") {

  x <- as.matrix(mat[, stages, drop = FALSE])
  ids <- mat[[id_col]]

  zero_cut <- as.numeric(
    quantile(
      as.numeric(x),
      zero_q,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      type = 7
    )
  )

  nz <- as.numeric(x)[as.numeric(x) >
    zero_cut]
  q <- as.numeric(
    quantile(
      nz,
      probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_levels + 1),


      na.rm = TRUE,
      type = 7
    )
  )

  # guard ties
  q <- unique(q)
  if ((length(q) -
    1) < n_levels) {
    warning("Quantile breaks collapsed; falling back to rank-binning.")
    out <- matrix(
      0L, nrow = nrow(x),
      ncol = ncol(x),
      dimnames = list(ids, stages)
    )
    keep <- x > zero_cut
    rk <- rank(x[keep], ties.method = "average")
    out[keep] <- pmax(
      1L, pmin(
        n_levels, floor(
          (rk - 1)/length(rk) *
          n_levels
        ) +
          1L
      )
    )
    return(out)
  }

  encode <- function(v) {
    out <- integer(length(v))
    keep <- v > zero_cut
    out[!keep] <- 0L
    out[keep] <- as.integer(cut(v[keep],
      breaks = q,
      labels = 1:n_levels,
      include.lowest = TRUE))
    out
  }

  out <- apply(x, 2, encode)
  rownames(out) <- ids
  storage.mode(out) <- "integer"
  out
}

catalog_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "data", "upstream", "final_tables")
atac <- read.csv(
  file.path(catalog_dir, "Supp_Table_1_ATAC_master.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
ac <- read.csv(
  file.path(catalog_dir, "Supp_Table_2_AC_master.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
me3 <- read.csv(
  file.path(catalog_dir, "Supp_Table_3_ME3_master.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
stages <- c("VZ", "SVZ", "ImN", "L6N", "L5N")
atac_stage <- build_stage_matrix(
  atac, construct_metadata(atac, "ATAC"),
  "_cpm"
)
ac_stage <- build_stage_matrix(
  ac, construct_metadata(ac, "AC"),
  "_fpkm"
)
me3_stage <- build_stage_matrix(
  me3, construct_metadata(me3, "ME3"),
  "_fpkm"
)
atac_ordinal <- ordinalize(atac_stage,
  stages,
  zero_q = 0.05,
  n_levels = 10)
ac_ordinal <- ordinalize(ac_stage,
  stages,
  zero_q = 0.05,
  n_levels = 10)
me3_ordinal <- ordinalize(me3_stage,
  stages,
  zero_q = 0.02,
  n_levels = 10)
```


## Assign stage trajectories to overlap records

The overlap catalog retains ±2.5-kb expanded interval coordinates. For each record, the original algorithm averages all overlapping peak-level ordinal vectors and rounds to integer levels. Entirely absent modality vectors become zero. Pairwise and three-way records remain separate counting units.

```{r integration-overlap-vectors, eval=isTRUE(params$run_integration)}
make_traj_gr <- function(program_levels) {

  df <- program_levels %>%
    mutate(ID_orig = ID) %>%
    separate(
      ID, into = c("chr", "start", "end"),
      sep = "_",
      convert = TRUE
    ) %>%
    mutate(program = factor(program,
      levels = stages)) %>%
    arrange(ID_orig, program) %>%
    group_by(ID_orig, chr, start, end) %>%
    summarise(
      vec = paste(level, collapse = "-"),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  GRanges(
    seqnames = df$chr,
    ranges = IRanges(df$start, df$end),

    vec = df$vec
  )
}

make_overlap_gr <- function(df, start_col, end_col) {

  keep <- !is.na(df[[start_col]]) &
    !is.na(df[[end_col]])

  GRanges(
    seqnames = df$Chromosome[keep],
    ranges = IRanges(df[[start_col]][keep], df[[end_col]][keep]),

    row_idx = which(keep)
  )
}

assign_by_overlap <- function(ov_gr, traj_gr, n_rows, stages) {

  out <- matrix(
    NA_integer_,
    nrow = n_rows,
    ncol = length(stages),

    dimnames = list(NULL, stages)
  )

  hits <- findOverlaps(ov_gr, traj_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) ==
    0)
    return(out)

  traj_mat <- as.matrix(
    mcols(traj_gr)[,
      stages, drop = FALSE]
  )
  storage.mode(traj_mat) <- "numeric"

  qh <- queryHits(hits)
  sh <- subjectHits(hits)

  # group subject hits by query hit index
  sh_by_q <- split(sh, qh)
  for (qi_chr in names(sh_by_q)) {
    qi <- as.integer(qi_chr)
    row_out <- mcols(ov_gr)$row_idx[qi]
    out[row_out, ] <- as.integer(round(colMeans(traj_mat[sh_by_q[[qi_chr]], , drop = FALSE],
      na.rm = TRUE)))
  }

  storage.mode(out) <- "integer"
  out
}

library(GenomicRanges)
library(IRanges)
all_overlaps_total <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    REPO, "data", "upstream", "integration", "all_overlaps_total_aug_with_Programs.csv"
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)
atac_gr <- make_traj_gr(atac_ordinal, atac, stages)
ac_gr <- make_traj_gr(ac_ordinal, ac, stages)
me3_gr <- make_traj_gr(me3_ordinal, me3, stages)
ATAC_mat <- assign_by_overlap(
  make_overlap_gr(all_overlaps_total, "ATAC_Start", "ATAC_End"),
  atac_gr, nrow(all_overlaps_total),
  stages
)
AC_mat <- assign_by_overlap(
  make_overlap_gr(all_overlaps_total, "AC_Start", "AC_End"),
  ac_gr, nrow(all_overlaps_total),
  stages
)
ME3_mat <- assign_by_overlap(
  make_overlap_gr(all_overlaps_total, "ME3_Start", "ME3_End"),
  me3_gr, nrow(all_overlaps_total),
  stages
)
zero_vec <- rep(0L, length(stages))
traj_df <- all_overlaps_total %>%
  mutate(
    ATAC_vec = asplit(ATAC_mat, 1),
    AC_vec = asplit(AC_mat, 1),
    ME3_vec = asplit(ME3_mat, 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      ends_with("_vec"),
      ~lapply(
        .x, function(v) {
          if (all(is.na(v)))
          zero_vec else as.integer(v)
        }
      )
    )
  )
```

## Pairwise feature engineering, UMAP and graph clustering

This is the selected original function, including level/slope/monotonicity/coupling features, anchor construction, PCA, UMAP, neighborhood graph construction, Leiden clustering and small-cluster merging. Its generic defaults are overridden by the manuscript calls below.

```{r run-pairwise-recluster-and-plots, eval=isTRUE(params$run_integration)}
run_pairwise_recluster_and_plots <- function(
  traj_df,
  connection = c("atac_ac", "atac_me3", "ac_me3"),

  # Back-compat / safety
  clustering_method = "umap_aligned",

  # ---- shared size control ----
  min_cluster_size = 500L,

  # ---- PCA dimensions (for initial dimensionality reduction) ----
  cluster_n_pcs = 30L,   # PCA dims BEFORE UMAP

  # ---- UMAP parameters (computed BEFORE clustering) ----
  n_neighbors = 25,
  min_dist = 0.05,
  umap_threads = 15,
  umap_metric = "euclidean",

  # ---- Clustering in UMAP space ----
  cluster_k_param    = 30L,       # kNN in UMAP space
  cluster_snn_k      = NULL,      # SNN neighbors in UMAP space
  cluster_resolution = 1.2,
  cluster_prune_snn  = 0.02,
  cluster_algorithm  = c("leiden", "louvain"),
  use_snn            = TRUE,

  # ---- output dirs ----
  out_plot_dir = file.path(REPO, "reports", "integration_recomputed"),
  out_obj_dir  = file.path(REPO, "objects", "integration", "recomputed"),

  # ---- core params ----
  stages = c("VZ","SVZ","ImN","L6N","L5N"),
  max_level = 10L,

  # ---- anchors (included in BOTH PCA + UMAP) ----
  use_anchors = TRUE,
  const_range_cut = 1L,
  const_sd_cut    = 0.75,
  level_breaks    = c(-Inf, 3.5, 7.5, Inf),
  target_anchor_ratio = 0.20,

  # ---- feature engineering toggles ----
  include_all_modalities = TRUE,
  include_monotonicity  = TRUE,
  include_coupling      = TRUE,

  # If TRUE, applied to features before PCA
  row_normalize_features = FALSE,

  # ---- parallelism (monotonicity sign-change bits) ----
  n_workers = 1L,
  parallel_threshold = 60000,

  # ---- feature inspection ----
  inspect_feature_matrix = TRUE,
  feature_head_n = 6,
  show_feature_names = FALSE,

  # ---- plotting aesthetics ----
  modality_colors = c(ATAC = "#D55E00", AC = "#009E73", ME3 = "#0072B2"),

  ribbon_alpha = 0.22,
  line_width = 0.9,
  point_size = 1.6,
  facet_ncol = 6,

  # ---- plot sizes ----
  umap_width  = 7.5 * 1.6,
  umap_height = 7.0 * 1.6,
  traj_width  = 14.5,
  traj_height = 9.5,

  # ---- filenames ----
  umap_prefix = "UMAP_pairwise",
  traj_prefix = "Trajectories_pairwise",

  # ---- behavior ----
  show_plots = TRUE,
  save_bundle = TRUE,
  seed = 42
) {

  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(tibble)
    library(uwot)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(ggrepel)
    library(scales)
    library(grid)
    library(Matrix)
    library(RANN)
    library(igraph)
    library(parallel)
  })

  if (!identical(clustering_method, "umap_aligned")) {
    stop("This function supports clustering_method = 'umap_aligned' only.")
  }

  connection <- match.arg(connection)
  cluster_algorithm <- match.arg(cluster_algorithm)
  set.seed(seed)

  dir.create(out_plot_dir,
    showWarnings = FALSE,
    recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create(out_obj_dir,
    showWarnings = FALSE,
    recursive = TRUE)

  dev_fun <- if (exists("cairo_pdf")) cairo_pdf else pdf
  p <- length(stages)
  zero_vec <- rep(0L, p)

  safe_num <- function(x) gsub("\\.", "p", as.character(x))

  # -----------------------------
  # Fast scaling
  # -----------------------------
  fast_scale <- function(X) {
    X <- as.matrix(X)
    X[!is.finite(X)] <- 0
    if (requireNamespace("matrixStats", quietly = TRUE)) {
      mu  <- matrixStats::colMeans2(X)
      sdv <- matrixStats::colSds(X, center = mu)
    } else {
      mu  <- colMeans(X)
      sdv <- apply(X, 2, sd)
    }
    sdv[!is.finite(sdv) | sdv == 0] <- 1
    Xz <- sweep(X, 2, mu, "-")
    Xz <- sweep(Xz, 2, sdv, "/")
    Xz[!is.finite(Xz)] <- 0
    Xz
  }

  safe_row_normalize <- function(X) {
    X <- as.matrix(X)
    rn <- sqrt(rowSums(X^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    rn[!is.finite(rn) | rn == 0] <- 1
    Xn <- sweep(X, 1, rn, "/")
    Xn[!is.finite(Xn)] <- 0
    Xn
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Robust vector parser
  # -----------------------------
  parse_stage_vec <- function(x, stages, zero_vec, max_level) {
    if (is.numeric(x) || is.integer(x)) {
      v <- as.integer(x)
    } else if (is.list(x) && length(x) == 1 && (is.numeric(x[[1]]) || is.integer(x[[1]]))) {
      v <- as.integer(x[[1]])
    } else if (is.character(x)) {
      parts <- trimws(strsplit(x, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
      parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
      v <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts))
    } else if (is.null(x) || (length(x) == 1 && is.na(x))) {
      v <- integer(0)
    } else {
      stop("Unsupported vector encoding type: ", paste(class(x), collapse = "/"))
    }

    if (length(v) == 0 || all(is.na(v))) return(zero_vec)
    if (length(v) != length(stages)) stop("Vector length mismatch: expected ", length(stages), " got ", length(v))
    if (any(v < 0, na.rm = TRUE) || any(v > max_level, na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Vector has values outside [0,",
      max_level,
      "]")
    v
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Anchors
  # -----------------------------
  const_bin <- function(v,
    const_range_cut = 1L,
    const_sd_cut = 0.75,
    level_breaks = c(-Inf, 3.5, 7.5, Inf)) {
    v <- as.numeric(v)
    mu  <- mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    sdv <- sd(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    rng <- diff(range(v, na.rm = TRUE))
    is_const <- is.finite(rng) && is.finite(sdv) && rng <= const_range_cut && sdv <= const_sd_cut
    if (!is_const) return("Dynamic")
    as.character(
      cut(mu, breaks = level_breaks,
          labels = c("Const_Low","Const_Med","Const_High"),
          include.lowest = TRUE)
    )
  }

  make_anchor_mm_4lvl <- function(bin, prefix) {
    lvl <- c("Const_Low","Const_Med","Const_High","Dynamic")
    bin <- factor(as.character(bin), levels = lvl)
    mm  <- model.matrix(~ 0 + bin)
    need <- paste0("bin", lvl)
    missing <- setdiff(need, colnames(mm))
    if (length(missing) > 0) {
      mm <- cbind(mm, matrix(0, nrow(mm), length(missing), dimnames = list(NULL, missing)))
    }
    mm <- mm[, need, drop = FALSE]
    colnames(mm) <- paste0(prefix, "_", lvl)
    mm
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Monotonic features
  # -----------------------------
  mono_mat <- function(mat,
    prefix,
    n_workers = 1L,
    parallel_ok = FALSE) {
    mat <- as.matrix(mat)
    n <- nrow(mat)
    p <- ncol(mat)
    dv <- mat[, -1, drop = FALSE] - mat[, -p, drop = FALSE]

    delta_total <- mat[, p] - mat[, 1]
    early_late  <- rowMeans(mat[, (p-1):p, drop = FALSE]) - rowMeans(mat[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])

    peak_pos   <- (max.col(mat,  ties.method = "first") - 1) / (p - 1)
    trough_pos <- (max.col(-mat, ties.method = "first") - 1) / (p - 1)

    max_slope_pos <- (max.col(dv,  ties.method = "first") - 1) / (ncol(dv) - 1)
    min_slope_pos <- (max.col(-dv, ties.method = "first") - 1) / (ncol(dv) - 1)

    sign_change_one <- function(x) {
      s <- sign(x); s <- s[is.finite(s) & s != 0]
      if (length(s) < 2) return(0L)
      sum(s[-1] != s[-length(s)])
    }
    is_mono_one <- function(x) {
      s <- sign(x); s <- s[is.finite(s) & s != 0]
      if (length(s) == 0) return(1L)
      as.integer(all(s >= 0) || all(s <= 0))
    }

    if (!parallel_ok || n_workers <= 1L) {
      n_sc <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) sign_change_one(dv[i, ]), integer(1))
      mono <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) is_mono_one(dv[i, ]), integer(1))
    } else {
      idx_chunks <- split(seq_len(n),
        cut(seq_len(n), breaks = n_workers, labels = FALSE))
      cl <- parallel::makeCluster(as.integer(n_workers))
      on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
      parallel::clusterExport(cl,
        varlist = c("dv","sign_change_one","is_mono_one"),
        envir = environment())
      out <- parallel::parLapply(cl, idx_chunks, function(ii) {
        list(
          n_sc = vapply(ii, function(i) sign_change_one(dv[i, ]), integer(1)),
          mono = vapply(ii, function(i) is_mono_one(dv[i, ]), integer(1))
        )
      })
      n_sc <- unlist(lapply(out, `[[`, "n_sc"), use.names = FALSE)
      mono <- unlist(lapply(out, `[[`, "mono"), use.names = FALSE)
    }

    out <- cbind(
      delta_total    = delta_total,
      early_late     = early_late,
      n_sign_changes = n_sc,
      is_monotonic   = mono,
      peak_pos       = peak_pos,
      trough_pos     = trough_pos,
      max_slope_pos  = max_slope_pos,
      min_slope_pos  = min_slope_pos
    )
    colnames(out) <- paste0(prefix, "_", colnames(out))
    out
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Rowwise correlation (vectorized)
  # -----------------------------
  row_cor <- function(A, B) {
    A <- as.matrix(A); B <- as.matrix(B)
    ma <- rowMeans(A, na.rm = TRUE)
    mb <- rowMeans(B, na.rm = TRUE)
    Ac <- A - ma
    Bc <- B - mb
    num <- rowSums(Ac * Bc, na.rm = TRUE)
    den <- sqrt(rowSums(Ac^2,
      na.rm = TRUE) * rowSums(Bc^2,
      na.rm = TRUE))
    out <- ifelse(is.finite(den) & den > 0, num / den, 0)
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- 0
    out
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Coupling features
  # -----------------------------
  coupling_mat <- function(A, B, prefix) {
    A <- as.matrix(A); B <- as.matrix(B)
    dvA <- A[, -1, drop = FALSE] - A[, -ncol(A), drop = FALSE]
    dvB <- B[, -1, drop = FALSE] - B[, -ncol(B), drop = FALSE]

    cor_level <- row_cor(A, B)
    cor_slope <- row_cor(dvA, dvB)

    diffAB <- A - B
    mean_abs_diff <- rowMeans(abs(diffAB), na.rm = TRUE)
    l2_dist <- sqrt(rowSums(diffAB^2, na.rm = TRUE))

    elA <- rowMeans(A[, (ncol(A)-1):ncol(A), drop = FALSE]) - rowMeans(A[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
    elB <- rowMeans(B[, (ncol(B)-1):ncol(B), drop = FALSE]) - rowMeans(B[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
    early_late_diff <- elA - elB

    out <- cbind(
      cor_level       = cor_level,
      cor_slope       = cor_slope,
      mean_abs_diff   = mean_abs_diff,
      l2_dist         = l2_dist,
      cos_shape       = cor_level,
      early_late_diff = early_late_diff
    )
    colnames(out) <- paste0(prefix, "_", colnames(out))
    out
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Relabel clusters 1..K by size
  # -----------------------------
  relabel_by_size <- function(lbl) {
    lbl <- as.integer(lbl)
    sz <- sort(table(lbl), decreasing = TRUE)
    old <- as.integer(names(sz))
    map <- setNames(seq_along(old), old)
    as.integer(map[as.character(lbl)])
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Merge small clusters into nearest big cluster (centroid-based)
  # -----------------------------
  merge_small_clusters <- function(X, lbl, min_size, fallback_big_n = 50L) {
    lbl <- as.integer(lbl)
    if (min_size <= 1) return(lbl)

    sz <- sort(table(lbl), decreasing = TRUE)
    labs <- as.integer(names(sz))

    big   <- as.integer(names(sz)[sz >= min_size])
    small <- as.integer(names(sz)[sz <  min_size])

    if (length(big) == 0L) {
      big <- labs[seq_len(min(length(labs), as.integer(fallback_big_n)))]
      small <- setdiff(labs, big)
    }
    if (length(small) == 0L || length(big) == 0L) return(lbl)

    cent_big <- do.call(rbind,
      lapply(big, function(k) colMeans(X[lbl == k, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)))
    rownames(cent_big) <- as.character(big)

    for (s in small) {
      idx_s <- which(lbl == s)
      if (length(idx_s) == 0L) next
      cent_s <- matrix(colMeans(X[idx_s, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
        nrow = 1)
      nn <- RANN::nn2(data = cent_big,
        query = cent_s,
        k = 1)
      target <- as.integer(rownames(cent_big)[nn$nn.idx[1, 1]])
      lbl[idx_s] <- target
    }
    lbl
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Graph clustering in UMAP space (2D)
  # -----------------------------
  cluster_in_umap_space <- function(umap_coords,
                                     k_param = 30L,
                                     snn_k = NULL,
                                     resolution = 1.2,
                                     prune_snn = 0.02,
                                     algorithm = c("leiden","louvain"),
                                     use_snn = TRUE,
                                     seed = 42) {

    algorithm <- match.arg(algorithm)
    set.seed(seed)

    emb <- as.matrix(umap_coords)
    emb[!is.finite(emb)] <- 0

    if (isTRUE(use_snn)) {
      if (is.null(snn_k)) snn_k <- min(as.integer(k_param), 200L)
      k_nn <- as.integer(snn_k)
    } else {
      k_nn <- as.integer(k_param)
    }

    nn <- RANN::nn2(emb, k = k_nn + 1L)
    idx  <- nn$nn.idx[, -1, drop = FALSE]
    dist <- nn$nn.dists[, -1, drop = FALSE]
    n <- nrow(idx)

    if (!isTRUE(use_snn)) {
      w <- 1 / (1 + as.vector(t(dist)))
      W <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
        i = rep(seq_len(n), each = k_nn),

        j = as.vector(t(idx)),
        x = w,
        dims = c(n, n)
      )
      W <- pmax(W, Matrix::t(W))
      W <- Matrix::drop0(W)
    } else {
      M <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
        i = rep(seq_len(n), each = k_nn),

        j = as.vector(t(idx)),
        x = 1,
        dims = c(n, n)
      )
      U <- M + Matrix::t(M); U@x[] <- 1
      S <- M %*% Matrix::t(M)
      W <- (S * U)
      diag(W) <- 0
      W@x <- W@x / (2 * k_nn - W@x)

      if (!is.null(prune_snn) && prune_snn > 0) {
        W@x[W@x < prune_snn] <- 0
      }
      W <- Matrix::drop0(W)

      if (length(W@x) == 0) {
        warning("SNN pruning removed all edges; falling back to weighted kNN graph.")
        w <- 1 / (1 + as.vector(t(dist)))
        W <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
          i = rep(seq_len(n), each = k_nn),

          j = as.vector(t(idx)),
          x = w,
          dims = c(n, n)
        )
        W <- pmax(W, Matrix::t(W))
        W <- Matrix::drop0(W)
      }
    }

    deg <- Matrix::rowSums(W != 0)
    diagnostics <- list(
      edges = length(W@x),
      mean_degree = mean(deg),
      frac_isolated = mean(deg == 0),
      k_nn_used = k_nn,
      space = "UMAP_2D"
    )

    g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(W,
      mode = "undirected",
      weighted = TRUE,
      diag = FALSE)

    if (algorithm == "leiden") {
      has_igraph_leiden <- "cluster_leiden" %in% getNamespaceExports("igraph")
      if (has_igraph_leiden) {
        cl <- igraph::cluster_leiden(g,
          resolution_parameter = resolution,
          weights = igraph::E(g)$weight)
        memb <- igraph::membership(cl)
      } else if (requireNamespace("leiden", quietly = TRUE)) {
        memb <- leiden::leiden(g,
          resolution_parameter = resolution,
          weights = igraph::E(g)$weight,
          seed = seed)
      } else {
        warning("Leiden not available; falling back to Louvain.")
        cl <- igraph::cluster_louvain(g, weights = igraph::E(g)$weight)
        memb <- igraph::membership(cl)
      }
    } else {
      cl <- igraph::cluster_louvain(g, weights = igraph::E(g)$weight)
      memb <- igraph::membership(cl)
    }

    list(cluster = as.integer(memb),
      graph = g,
      W = W,
      diagnostics = diagnostics)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 1) Pairwise subset
  # ============================================================
  miss <- function(x) is.na(x) | x == 0

  df <- switch(
    connection,
    atac_ac  = traj_df %>% filter(!miss(idx_atac), !miss(idx_ac),  miss(idx_me3)),
    atac_me3 = traj_df %>% filter(!miss(idx_atac),  miss(idx_ac), !miss(idx_me3)),
    ac_me3   = traj_df %>% filter( miss(idx_atac), !miss(idx_ac), !miss(idx_me3))
  )
  if (nrow(df) == 0) stop("No rows found for connection = ", connection)

  mods_pair <- switch(
    connection,
    atac_ac  = c("ATAC","AC"),
    atac_me3 = c("ATAC","ME3"),
    ac_me3   = c("AC","ME3")
  )
  mods_feat <- if (isTRUE(include_all_modalities)) c("ATAC","AC","ME3") else mods_pair

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      ATAC_vec = lapply(ATAC_vec, parse_stage_vec, stages = stages, zero_vec = zero_vec, max_level = max_level),

      AC_vec   = lapply(AC_vec,   parse_stage_vec, stages = stages, zero_vec = zero_vec, max_level = max_level),

      ME3_vec  = lapply(ME3_vec,
      parse_stage_vec,
      stages = stages,
      zero_vec = zero_vec,
      max_level = max_level)
    )

  mat_for <- function(mod) {
    vv <- df[[paste0(mod, "_vec")]]
    m <- matrix(unlist(vv, use.names = FALSE),
      ncol = length(stages),
      byrow = TRUE)
    colnames(m) <- paste0(mod, "_", stages)
    storage.mode(m) <- "integer"
    m
  }

  MAT <- lapply(mods_feat, mat_for)
  names(MAT) <- mods_feat

  # ============================================================
  # 2) Engineered feature matrix (NO PROFILES)
  # ============================================================
  X_levels <- do.call(cbind, MAT)

  get_slopes <- function(mat, mod) {
    d <- mat[, -1, drop = FALSE] - mat[, -ncol(mat), drop = FALSE]
    colnames(d) <- paste0("d", mod, "_", stages[-1], "_minus_", stages[-p])
    d
  }
  X_slopes <- do.call(cbind, lapply(names(MAT), function(m) get_slopes(MAT[[m]], m)))

  X_mono <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(include_monotonicity)) {
    parallel_ok <- (as.integer(n_workers) > 1L) && (nrow(df) >= as.integer(parallel_threshold))
    X_mono <- do.call(cbind, lapply(names(MAT), function(m) {
      mono_mat(MAT[[m]],
        prefix = m,
        n_workers = n_workers,
        parallel_ok = parallel_ok)
    }))
  }

  X_couple <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(include_coupling)) {
    pairs <- combn(names(MAT), 2, simplify = FALSE)
    X_couple <- do.call(cbind, lapply(pairs, function(pr) {
      m1 <- pr[1]; m2 <- pr[2]
      coupling_mat(MAT[[m1]], MAT[[m2]], prefix = paste0(m1, "_", m2))
    }))
  }

  X_cont  <- cbind(X_levels, X_slopes, X_mono, X_couple)
  Xz_cont <- fast_scale(X_cont)

  if (isTRUE(inspect_feature_matrix)) {
    message("===== Feature matrix: Xz_cont (engineered; NO profiles) =====")
    message("dim: ", nrow(Xz_cont), " x ", ncol(Xz_cont))
    if (isTRUE(show_feature_names)) message("features: ", paste(colnames(Xz_cont), collapse = ", "))
    print(utils::head(Xz_cont, feature_head_n))
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 3) Anchors + unified matrix for PCA → UMAP → clustering
  # ============================================================
  anchor_mm <- NULL
  w_anchor <- 0
  X_for_pca <- Xz_cont

  if (isTRUE(use_anchors)) {
    bin_list <- lapply(names(MAT), function(m) {
      apply(MAT[[m]], 1, const_bin,
            const_range_cut = const_range_cut,
            const_sd_cut    = const_sd_cut,
            level_breaks    = level_breaks)
    })
    names(bin_list) <- names(MAT)
    anchor_mm <- do.call(cbind, lapply(names(bin_list), function(m) make_anchor_mm_4lvl(bin_list[[m]], m)))

    cont_norm   <- sqrt(rowSums(Xz_cont^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    anchor_norm <- sqrt(rowSums(anchor_mm^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    anchor_norm[!is.finite(anchor_norm) | anchor_norm == 0] <- 1

    w_anchor <- target_anchor_ratio *
      median(cont_norm, na.rm = TRUE) /
      median(anchor_norm, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(w_anchor)) w_anchor <- 0

    X_for_pca <- cbind(Xz_cont, w_anchor * anchor_mm)
    X_for_pca[!is.finite(X_for_pca)] <- 0
  }

  if (isTRUE(row_normalize_features)) {
    X_for_pca <- safe_row_normalize(X_for_pca)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 4) PCA → UMAP → Cluster in UMAP space
  # ============================================================

  # Step 4a: PCA dimensionality reduction
  set.seed(seed)
  X_use <- as.matrix(X_for_pca)
  X_use[!is.finite(X_use)] <- 0

  if (!is.null(cluster_n_pcs) && cluster_n_pcs > 1L && ncol(X_use) > 2L) {
    npc <- min(as.integer(cluster_n_pcs), ncol(X_use) - 1L)
    if (requireNamespace("irlba", quietly = TRUE)) {
      pca_emb <- irlba::prcomp_irlba(X_use,
        n = npc,
        center = TRUE,
        scale. = FALSE)$x
    } else {
      pca_emb <- stats::prcomp(X_use,
        rank. = npc,
        center = TRUE,
        scale. = FALSE)$x
    }
    message("PCA: Reduced to ", ncol(pca_emb), " dimensions for UMAP input")
  } else {
    pca_emb <- X_use
    message("PCA: Skipped (using full feature matrix for UMAP)")
  }

  # Step 4b: UMAP from PCA embedding
  set.seed(seed)
  umap_input <- as.matrix(pca_emb)
  umap_input[!is.finite(umap_input)] <- 0

  message("Computing UMAP from PCA space...")
  um <- uwot::umap(
    umap_input,
    n_neighbors = n_neighbors,
    min_dist    = min_dist,
    metric      = umap_metric,
    n_threads   = umap_threads
  )
  message("UMAP computed: ", nrow(um), " points in 2D space")

  # Step 4c: Cluster in UMAP space (THIS IS THE KEY CHANGE)
  message("Clustering in UMAP space (ensures alignment with visualization)...")
  gc <- cluster_in_umap_space(
    um,
    k_param    = as.integer(cluster_k_param),
    snn_k      = cluster_snn_k,
    resolution = cluster_resolution,
    prune_snn  = cluster_prune_snn,
    algorithm  = cluster_algorithm,
    use_snn    = use_snn,
    seed       = seed
  )

  cl_raw <- as.integer(gc$cluster)
  cl_raw <- merge_small_clusters(um, cl_raw, min_size = as.integer(min_cluster_size))
  cl_raw <- relabel_by_size(cl_raw)
  df$two_way_cluster <- factor(cl_raw)

  message(sprintf(
    "Graph diagnostics: edges=%s | mean_degree=%.2f | isolated=%.1f%% | kNN_used=%d | space=%s",

    scales::comma(gc$diagnostics$edges),
    gc$diagnostics$mean_degree,
    100 * gc$diagnostics$frac_isolated,
    gc$diagnostics$k_nn_used,
    gc$diagnostics$space
  ))

  tab <- dplyr::count(tibble(cluster = df$two_way_cluster),
    cluster,
    name = "n") %>%
    mutate(frac = n / sum(n))

  algo_note <- paste0(
    "UMAP-aligned clustering (", cluster_algorithm,
    ", use_snn=", use_snn,
    ", k=", cluster_k_param,
    ifelse(isTRUE(use_snn), paste0(", snn_k=", gc$diagnostics$k_nn_used), ""),
    ", res=", cluster_resolution,
    ", prune=", signif(cluster_prune_snn, 3),
    ", merge<", min_cluster_size, ")"
  )

  algo_suffix <- paste0(
    "umap_aligned_",
    cluster_algorithm,
    "_k", cluster_k_param,
    ifelse(isTRUE(use_snn), paste0("_snn", gc$diagnostics$k_nn_used), "_knn"),
    "_pcs", ifelse(is.null(cluster_n_pcs), "full", cluster_n_pcs),
    "_unn", n_neighbors,
    "_res", safe_num(cluster_resolution),
    "_pr", safe_num(cluster_prune_snn),
    "_m", min_cluster_size,
    ifelse(isTRUE(use_anchors), paste0("_anch", safe_num(signif(w_anchor, 3))), "_noanch"),
    ifelse(isTRUE(include_monotonicity), "_mono", "_nomono"),
    ifelse(isTRUE(include_coupling), "_coup", "_nocoup")
  )

  message(
    "Engineered features. Profiles=OFF; Monotonicity=",
    ifelse(include_monotonicity, "ON", "OFF"),

    "; Coupling=", ifelse(include_coupling, "ON", "OFF"),
    "; Anchors=", ifelse(use_anchors, "ON", "OFF"),
    ifelse(use_anchors, paste0(" | w_anchor=", signif(w_anchor, 3)), ""),
    ifelse(row_normalize_features, " | row_norm=ON", " | row_norm=OFF"),

    " | PCA dims=", ncol(pca_emb),
    " | UMAP n_neighbors=", n_neighbors,
    " | clustering=", algo_note,
    " | K=", dplyr::n_distinct(df$two_way_cluster)
  )

  # ============================================================
  # 5) UMAP plot with clusters
  # ============================================================
  umap_df <- df %>% mutate(UMAP1 = um[, 1],
    UMAP2 = um[, 2])

  label_df <- umap_df %>%
    group_by(two_way_cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      UMAP1 = median(UMAP1, na.rm = TRUE),

      UMAP2 = median(UMAP2, na.rm = TRUE),

      n     = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(two_way_cluster,
      "\n(n=",
      n,
      ")"))

  p_umap <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = two_way_cluster)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.22,
      alpha = 0.55) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, label = label),

      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      fill  = scales::alpha("white", 0.40),
      label.size = 0.20,
      size = 3.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      seed = seed
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.5,
      alpha = 1))) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.width  = grid::unit(0.5, "cm")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Pairwise chromatin programs: ", connection, " (engineered features; NO profiles)"),
      subtitle = paste0("UMAP computed from PCA (", ncol(pca_emb), " dims). Clustering = ", algo_note, " [IN UMAP SPACE]"),

      color = "Cluster"
    )

  umap_stem <- paste0(umap_prefix, "_", connection, "_", algo_suffix)
  umap_pdf  <- file.path(out_plot_dir, paste0(umap_stem, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(umap_pdf,
    p_umap,
    width = umap_width,
    height = umap_height,
    units = "in",
    device = dev_fun)
  if (isTRUE(show_plots)) print(p_umap)

  # ============================================================
  # 6) Trajectory plot (pair modalities only)
  # ============================================================
  vec_to_long <- function(df_in, mod) {
    mat <- matrix(unlist(df_in[[paste0(mod, "_vec")]], use.names = FALSE),
      ncol = length(stages),
      byrow = TRUE)
    colnames(mat) <- stages
    as.data.frame(mat) %>%
      mutate(row_id = seq_len(nrow(mat))) %>%
      pivot_longer(-row_id,
        names_to = "Stage",
        values_to = "quantile_value") %>%
      mutate(Modality = mod)
  }

  longA <- vec_to_long(umap_df, mods_pair[1])
  longB <- vec_to_long(umap_df, mods_pair[2])

  traj_long <- bind_rows(longA, longB) %>%
    left_join(
      umap_df %>% transmute(row_id = dplyr::row_number(), cluster = as.character(two_way_cluster)),

      by = "row_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Stage    = factor(Stage, levels = stages),

      Modality = factor(Modality, levels = c("ATAC","AC","ME3")),

      cluster  = factor(cluster,
      levels = levels(umap_df$two_way_cluster))
    )

  cluster_n <- traj_long %>%
    distinct(row_id, cluster) %>%
    dplyr::count(cluster, name = "n")

  traj_summary <- traj_long %>%
    group_by(cluster, Modality, Stage) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_quantile = mean(quantile_value, na.rm = TRUE),

      sd_quantile   = sd(quantile_value, na.rm = TRUE),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(cluster_n, by = "cluster") %>%
    mutate(
      ymin = pmax(0, mean_quantile - sd_quantile),
      ymax = pmin(max_level, mean_quantile + sd_quantile),
      cluster_label = paste0(as.character(cluster),
      "\n(n=",
      n,
      ")")
    )

  label_levels <- traj_summary %>%
    distinct(cluster, cluster_label) %>%
    mutate(ord = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(cluster)))) %>%
    arrange(ord) %>%
    pull(cluster_label)
  traj_summary$cluster_label <- factor(traj_summary$cluster_label, levels = label_levels)

  p_traj <- ggplot(traj_summary,
    aes(Stage, mean_quantile, color = Modality, group = Modality)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = line_width) +
    geom_point(size = point_size) +
    facet_wrap(~ cluster_label, ncol = facet_ncol) +
    scale_color_manual(values = modality_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_level),
      breaks = seq(0, max_level, 2)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),

      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),

      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),

      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Developmental stage",
      y = "Mean quantized signal level (0–10)",
      color = "Modality",
      title = paste0("Mean quantized chromatin trajectories (", connection, ")"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Clusters aligned with UMAP (", algo_note, ")\n",
        "Band = ±1 SD across loci within cluster"
      )
    )

  traj_stem <- paste0(traj_prefix, "_", connection, "_", algo_suffix)
  traj_pdf  <- file.path(out_plot_dir, paste0(traj_stem, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(traj_pdf,
    p_traj,
    width = traj_width,
    height = traj_height,
    units = "in",
    device = dev_fun)
  if (isTRUE(show_plots)) print(p_traj)

  # ============================================================
  # 7) Bundle
  # ============================================================
  bundle <- list(
    connection = connection,
    modalities_pair = mods_pair,
    modalities_features = mods_feat,
    stages = stages,
    max_level = max_level,

    feature_engineering = list(
      include_all_modalities = include_all_modalities,
      include_monotonicity = include_monotonicity,
      include_coupling = include_coupling
    ),

    use_anchors = use_anchors,
    w_anchor = w_anchor,
    anchor_mm = anchor_mm,
    row_normalize_features = row_normalize_features,

    clustering_note = algo_note,
    algo_suffix = algo_suffix,
    min_cluster_size = as.integer(min_cluster_size),
    clustering_obj = gc,
    cluster_table = tab,

    X_cont = X_cont,
    Xz_cont = Xz_cont,
    X_for_pca = X_for_pca,
    pca_embedding = pca_emb,

    umap_coords = um,
    umap_df = umap_df,
    umap_plot = p_umap,

    traj_plot = p_traj,
    traj_summary = traj_summary,

    files = list(
      umap_pdf = umap_pdf,
      traj_pdf = traj_pdf
    ),

    params = list(
      n_neighbors = n_neighbors,
      min_dist = min_dist,
      umap_threads = umap_threads,
      umap_metric = umap_metric,
      cluster_k_param = cluster_k_param,
      cluster_snn_k = cluster_snn_k,
      cluster_n_pcs = cluster_n_pcs,
      cluster_resolution = cluster_resolution,
      cluster_prune_snn = cluster_prune_snn,
      cluster_algorithm = cluster_algorithm,
      use_snn = use_snn,
      seed = seed
    )
  )

  if (isTRUE(save_bundle)) {
    bundle_rds <- file.path(out_obj_dir, paste0(umap_stem, ".rds"))
    saveRDS(bundle, bundle_rds)
    bundle$files$bundle_rds <- bundle_rds
  }

  invisible(bundle)
}
```

## Three-way feature engineering, UMAP and graph clustering

This is the selected original function, including level/slope/monotonicity/coupling features, anchor construction, PCA, UMAP, neighborhood graph construction, Leiden clustering and small-cluster merging. Its generic defaults are overridden by the manuscript calls below.

```{r run-threeway-recluster-and-plots, eval=isTRUE(params$run_integration)}
run_threeway_recluster_and_plots <- function(
  traj_df,

  # Back-compat / safety
  clustering_method = "umap_aligned",

  # ---- shared size control ----
  min_cluster_size = 500L,

  # ---- PCA dimensions (for initial dimensionality reduction) ----
  cluster_n_pcs = 30L,   # PCA dims BEFORE UMAP

  # ---- UMAP parameters (computed BEFORE clustering) ----
  n_neighbors = 25,
  min_dist = 0.05,
  umap_threads = 15,
  umap_metric = "euclidean",

  # ---- Clustering in UMAP space ----
  cluster_k_param    = 30L,       # kNN in UMAP space
  cluster_snn_k      = NULL,      # SNN neighbors in UMAP space
  cluster_resolution = 1.2,
  cluster_prune_snn  = 0.02,
  cluster_algorithm  = c("leiden", "louvain"),
  use_snn            = TRUE,

  # ---- output dirs ----
  out_plot_dir = file.path(REPO, "reports", "integration_recomputed"),
  out_obj_dir  = file.path(REPO, "objects", "integration", "recomputed"),

  # ---- core params ----
  stages = c("VZ","SVZ","ImN","L6N","L5N"),
  max_level = 10L,

  # ---- anchors (included in BOTH PCA + UMAP) ----
  use_anchors = TRUE,
  const_range_cut = 1L,
  const_sd_cut    = 0.75,
  level_breaks    = c(-Inf, 3.5, 7.5, Inf),
  target_anchor_ratio = 0.20,

  # ---- feature engineering toggles ----
  # (kept for symmetry; three-way always has all 3 modalities available)
  include_monotonicity  = TRUE,
  include_coupling      = TRUE,

  # If TRUE, applied to features before PCA
  row_normalize_features = FALSE,

  # ---- parallelism (monotonicity sign-change bits) ----
  n_workers = 1L,
  parallel_threshold = 60000,

  # ---- feature inspection ----
  inspect_feature_matrix = TRUE,
  feature_head_n = 6,
  show_feature_names = FALSE,

  # ---- plotting aesthetics ----
  modality_colors = c(ATAC = "#D55E00", AC = "#009E73", ME3 = "#0072B2"),

  ribbon_alpha = 0.22,
  line_width = 0.9,
  point_size = 1.6,
  facet_ncol = 6,

  # ---- plot sizes ----
  umap_width  = 7.5 * 1.6,
  umap_height = 7.0 * 1.6,
  traj_width  = 14.5,
  traj_height = 9.5,

  # ---- filenames ----
  umap_prefix = "UMAP_threeway",
  traj_prefix = "Trajectories_threeway",

  # ---- behavior ----
  show_plots = TRUE,
  save_bundle = TRUE,
  seed = 42
) {

  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(tibble)
    library(uwot)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(ggrepel)
    library(scales)
    library(grid)
    library(Matrix)
    library(RANN)
    library(igraph)
    library(parallel)
  })

  if (!identical(clustering_method, "umap_aligned")) {
    stop("This function supports clustering_method = 'umap_aligned' only.")
  }

  cluster_algorithm <- match.arg(cluster_algorithm)
  set.seed(seed)

  dir.create(out_plot_dir,
    showWarnings = FALSE,
    recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create(out_obj_dir,
    showWarnings = FALSE,
    recursive = TRUE)

  dev_fun <- if (exists("cairo_pdf")) cairo_pdf else pdf
  p <- length(stages)
  zero_vec <- rep(0L, p)

  safe_num <- function(x) gsub("\\.", "p", as.character(x))

  # -----------------------------
  # Fast scaling
  # -----------------------------
  fast_scale <- function(X) {
    X <- as.matrix(X)
    X[!is.finite(X)] <- 0
    if (requireNamespace("matrixStats", quietly = TRUE)) {
      mu  <- matrixStats::colMeans2(X)
      sdv <- matrixStats::colSds(X, center = mu)
    } else {
      mu  <- colMeans(X)
      sdv <- apply(X, 2, sd)
    }
    sdv[!is.finite(sdv) | sdv == 0] <- 1
    Xz <- sweep(X, 2, mu, "-")
    Xz <- sweep(Xz, 2, sdv, "/")
    Xz[!is.finite(Xz)] <- 0
    Xz
  }

  safe_row_normalize <- function(X) {
    X <- as.matrix(X)
    rn <- sqrt(rowSums(X^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    rn[!is.finite(rn) | rn == 0] <- 1
    Xn <- sweep(X, 1, rn, "/")
    Xn[!is.finite(Xn)] <- 0
    Xn
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Robust vector parser
  # -----------------------------
  parse_stage_vec <- function(x, stages, zero_vec, max_level) {
    if (is.numeric(x) || is.integer(x)) {
      v <- as.integer(x)
    } else if (is.list(x) && length(x) == 1 && (is.numeric(x[[1]]) || is.integer(x[[1]]))) {
      v <- as.integer(x[[1]])
    } else if (is.character(x)) {
      parts <- trimws(strsplit(x, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
      parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
      v <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts))
    } else if (is.null(x) || (length(x) == 1 && is.na(x))) {
      v <- integer(0)
    } else {
      stop("Unsupported vector encoding type: ", paste(class(x), collapse = "/"))
    }

    if (length(v) == 0 || all(is.na(v))) return(zero_vec)
    if (length(v) != length(stages)) stop("Vector length mismatch: expected ", length(stages), " got ", length(v))
    if (any(v < 0, na.rm = TRUE) || any(v > max_level, na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Vector has values outside [0,",
      max_level,
      "]")
    v
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Anchors
  # -----------------------------
  const_bin <- function(v,
    const_range_cut = 1L,
    const_sd_cut = 0.75,
    level_breaks = c(-Inf, 3.5, 7.5, Inf)) {
    v <- as.numeric(v)
    mu  <- mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    sdv <- sd(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    rng <- diff(range(v, na.rm = TRUE))
    is_const <- is.finite(rng) && is.finite(sdv) && rng <= const_range_cut && sdv <= const_sd_cut
    if (!is_const) return("Dynamic")
    as.character(
      cut(mu, breaks = level_breaks,
          labels = c("Const_Low","Const_Med","Const_High"),
          include.lowest = TRUE)
    )
  }

  make_anchor_mm_4lvl <- function(bin, prefix) {
    lvl <- c("Const_Low","Const_Med","Const_High","Dynamic")
    bin <- factor(as.character(bin), levels = lvl)
    mm  <- model.matrix(~ 0 + bin)
    need <- paste0("bin", lvl)
    missing <- setdiff(need, colnames(mm))
    if (length(missing) > 0) {
      mm <- cbind(mm, matrix(0, nrow(mm), length(missing), dimnames = list(NULL, missing)))
    }
    mm <- mm[, need, drop = FALSE]
    colnames(mm) <- paste0(prefix, "_", lvl)
    mm
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Monotonic features
  # -----------------------------
  mono_mat <- function(mat,
    prefix,
    n_workers = 1L,
    parallel_ok = FALSE) {
    mat <- as.matrix(mat)
    n <- nrow(mat)
    p <- ncol(mat)
    dv <- mat[, -1, drop = FALSE] - mat[, -p, drop = FALSE]

    delta_total <- mat[, p] - mat[, 1]
    early_late  <- rowMeans(mat[, (p-1):p, drop = FALSE]) - rowMeans(mat[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])

    peak_pos   <- (max.col(mat,  ties.method = "first") - 1) / (p - 1)
    trough_pos <- (max.col(-mat, ties.method = "first") - 1) / (p - 1)

    max_slope_pos <- (max.col(dv,  ties.method = "first") - 1) / (ncol(dv) - 1)
    min_slope_pos <- (max.col(-dv, ties.method = "first") - 1) / (ncol(dv) - 1)

    sign_change_one <- function(x) {
      s <- sign(x); s <- s[is.finite(s) & s != 0]
      if (length(s) < 2) return(0L)
      sum(s[-1] != s[-length(s)])
    }
    is_mono_one <- function(x) {
      s <- sign(x); s <- s[is.finite(s) & s != 0]
      if (length(s) == 0) return(1L)
      as.integer(all(s >= 0) || all(s <= 0))
    }

    if (!parallel_ok || n_workers <= 1L) {
      n_sc <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) sign_change_one(dv[i, ]), integer(1))
      mono <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) is_mono_one(dv[i, ]), integer(1))
    } else {
      idx_chunks <- split(seq_len(n),
        cut(seq_len(n), breaks = n_workers, labels = FALSE))
      cl <- parallel::makeCluster(as.integer(n_workers))
      on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
      parallel::clusterExport(cl,
        varlist = c("dv","sign_change_one","is_mono_one"),
        envir = environment())
      out <- parallel::parLapply(cl, idx_chunks, function(ii) {
        list(
          n_sc = vapply(ii, function(i) sign_change_one(dv[i, ]), integer(1)),
          mono = vapply(ii, function(i) is_mono_one(dv[i, ]), integer(1))
        )
      })
      n_sc <- unlist(lapply(out, `[[`, "n_sc"), use.names = FALSE)
      mono <- unlist(lapply(out, `[[`, "mono"), use.names = FALSE)
    }

    out <- cbind(
      delta_total    = delta_total,
      early_late     = early_late,
      n_sign_changes = n_sc,
      is_monotonic   = mono,
      peak_pos       = peak_pos,
      trough_pos     = trough_pos,
      max_slope_pos  = max_slope_pos,
      min_slope_pos  = min_slope_pos
    )
    colnames(out) <- paste0(prefix, "_", colnames(out))
    out
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Rowwise correlation (vectorized)
  # -----------------------------
  row_cor <- function(A, B) {
    A <- as.matrix(A); B <- as.matrix(B)
    ma <- rowMeans(A, na.rm = TRUE)
    mb <- rowMeans(B, na.rm = TRUE)
    Ac <- A - ma
    Bc <- B - mb
    num <- rowSums(Ac * Bc, na.rm = TRUE)
    den <- sqrt(rowSums(Ac^2,
      na.rm = TRUE) * rowSums(Bc^2,
      na.rm = TRUE))
    out <- ifelse(is.finite(den) & den > 0, num / den, 0)
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- 0
    out
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Coupling features
  # -----------------------------
  coupling_mat <- function(A, B, prefix) {
    A <- as.matrix(A); B <- as.matrix(B)
    dvA <- A[, -1, drop = FALSE] - A[, -ncol(A), drop = FALSE]
    dvB <- B[, -1, drop = FALSE] - B[, -ncol(B), drop = FALSE]

    cor_level <- row_cor(A, B)
    cor_slope <- row_cor(dvA, dvB)

    diffAB <- A - B
    mean_abs_diff <- rowMeans(abs(diffAB), na.rm = TRUE)
    l2_dist <- sqrt(rowSums(diffAB^2, na.rm = TRUE))

    elA <- rowMeans(A[, (ncol(A)-1):ncol(A), drop = FALSE]) - rowMeans(A[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
    elB <- rowMeans(B[, (ncol(B)-1):ncol(B), drop = FALSE]) - rowMeans(B[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
    early_late_diff <- elA - elB

    out <- cbind(
      cor_level       = cor_level,
      cor_slope       = cor_slope,
      mean_abs_diff   = mean_abs_diff,
      l2_dist         = l2_dist,
      cos_shape       = cor_level,
      early_late_diff = early_late_diff
    )
    colnames(out) <- paste0(prefix, "_", colnames(out))
    out
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Relabel clusters 1..K by size
  # -----------------------------
  relabel_by_size <- function(lbl) {
    lbl <- as.integer(lbl)
    sz <- sort(table(lbl), decreasing = TRUE)
    old <- as.integer(names(sz))
    map <- setNames(seq_along(old), old)
    as.integer(map[as.character(lbl)])
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Merge small clusters into nearest big cluster (centroid-based)
  # -----------------------------
  merge_small_clusters <- function(X, lbl, min_size, fallback_big_n = 50L) {
    lbl <- as.integer(lbl)
    if (min_size <= 1) return(lbl)

    sz <- sort(table(lbl), decreasing = TRUE)
    labs <- as.integer(names(sz))

    big   <- as.integer(names(sz)[sz >= min_size])
    small <- as.integer(names(sz)[sz <  min_size])

    if (length(big) == 0L) {
      big <- labs[seq_len(min(length(labs), as.integer(fallback_big_n)))]
      small <- setdiff(labs, big)
    }
    if (length(small) == 0L || length(big) == 0L) return(lbl)

    cent_big <- do.call(rbind,
      lapply(big, function(k) colMeans(X[lbl == k, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)))
    rownames(cent_big) <- as.character(big)

    for (s in small) {
      idx_s <- which(lbl == s)
      if (length(idx_s) == 0L) next
      cent_s <- matrix(colMeans(X[idx_s, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
        nrow = 1)
      nn <- RANN::nn2(data = cent_big,
        query = cent_s,
        k = 1)
      target <- as.integer(rownames(cent_big)[nn$nn.idx[1, 1]])
      lbl[idx_s] <- target
    }
    lbl
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # Graph clustering in UMAP space (2D)
  # -----------------------------
  cluster_in_umap_space <- function(umap_coords,
                                    k_param = 30L,
                                    snn_k = NULL,
                                    resolution = 1.2,
                                    prune_snn = 0.02,
                                    algorithm = c("leiden","louvain"),
                                    use_snn = TRUE,
                                    seed = 42) {

    algorithm <- match.arg(algorithm)
    set.seed(seed)

    emb <- as.matrix(umap_coords)
    emb[!is.finite(emb)] <- 0

    if (isTRUE(use_snn)) {
      if (is.null(snn_k)) snn_k <- min(as.integer(k_param), 200L)
      k_nn <- as.integer(snn_k)
    } else {
      k_nn <- as.integer(k_param)
    }

    nn <- RANN::nn2(emb, k = k_nn + 1L)
    idx  <- nn$nn.idx[, -1, drop = FALSE]
    dist <- nn$nn.dists[, -1, drop = FALSE]
    n <- nrow(idx)

    if (!isTRUE(use_snn)) {
      w <- 1 / (1 + as.vector(t(dist)))
      W <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
        i = rep(seq_len(n), each = k_nn),

        j = as.vector(t(idx)),
        x = w,
        dims = c(n, n)
      )
      W <- pmax(W, Matrix::t(W))
      W <- Matrix::drop0(W)
    } else {
      M <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
        i = rep(seq_len(n), each = k_nn),

        j = as.vector(t(idx)),
        x = 1,
        dims = c(n, n)
      )
      U <- M + Matrix::t(M); U@x[] <- 1
      S <- M %*% Matrix::t(M)
      W <- (S * U)
      diag(W) <- 0
      W@x <- W@x / (2 * k_nn - W@x)

      if (!is.null(prune_snn) && prune_snn > 0) {
        W@x[W@x < prune_snn] <- 0
      }
      W <- Matrix::drop0(W)

      if (length(W@x) == 0) {
        warning("SNN pruning removed all edges; falling back to weighted kNN graph.")
        w <- 1 / (1 + as.vector(t(dist)))
        W <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
          i = rep(seq_len(n), each = k_nn),

          j = as.vector(t(idx)),
          x = w,
          dims = c(n, n)
        )
        W <- pmax(W, Matrix::t(W))
        W <- Matrix::drop0(W)
      }
    }

    deg <- Matrix::rowSums(W != 0)
    diagnostics <- list(
      edges = length(W@x),
      mean_degree = mean(deg),
      frac_isolated = mean(deg == 0),
      k_nn_used = k_nn,
      space = "UMAP_2D"
    )

    g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(W,
      mode = "undirected",
      weighted = TRUE,
      diag = FALSE)

    if (algorithm == "leiden") {
      has_igraph_leiden <- "cluster_leiden" %in% getNamespaceExports("igraph")
      if (has_igraph_leiden) {
        cl <- igraph::cluster_leiden(g,
          resolution_parameter = resolution,
          weights = igraph::E(g)$weight)
        memb <- igraph::membership(cl)
      } else if (requireNamespace("leiden", quietly = TRUE)) {
        memb <- leiden::leiden(g,
          resolution_parameter = resolution,
          weights = igraph::E(g)$weight,
          seed = seed)
      } else {
        warning("Leiden not available; falling back to Louvain.")
        cl <- igraph::cluster_louvain(g, weights = igraph::E(g)$weight)
        memb <- igraph::membership(cl)
      }
    } else {
      cl <- igraph::cluster_louvain(g, weights = igraph::E(g)$weight)
      memb <- igraph::membership(cl)
    }

    list(cluster = as.integer(memb),
      graph = g,
      W = W,
      diagnostics = diagnostics)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 1) Three-way subset
  # ============================================================
  miss <- function(x) is.na(x) | x == 0

  df <- traj_df %>%
    filter(!miss(idx_atac), !miss(idx_ac), !miss(idx_me3))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) stop("No three-way rows found: require idx_atac, idx_ac, idx_me3 all non-missing/nonzero.")

  mods_feat <- c("ATAC","AC","ME3")

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      ATAC_vec = lapply(ATAC_vec, parse_stage_vec, stages = stages, zero_vec = zero_vec, max_level = max_level),

      AC_vec   = lapply(AC_vec,   parse_stage_vec, stages = stages, zero_vec = zero_vec, max_level = max_level),

      ME3_vec  = lapply(ME3_vec,
      parse_stage_vec,
      stages = stages,
      zero_vec = zero_vec,
      max_level = max_level)
    )

  mat_for <- function(mod) {
    vv <- df[[paste0(mod, "_vec")]]
    m <- matrix(unlist(vv, use.names = FALSE),
      ncol = length(stages),
      byrow = TRUE)
    colnames(m) <- paste0(mod, "_", stages)
    storage.mode(m) <- "integer"
    m
  }

  MAT <- lapply(mods_feat, mat_for)
  names(MAT) <- mods_feat

  # ============================================================
  # 2) Engineered feature matrix (NO PROFILES)
  # ============================================================
  X_levels <- do.call(cbind, MAT)

  get_slopes <- function(mat, mod) {
    d <- mat[, -1, drop = FALSE] - mat[, -ncol(mat), drop = FALSE]
    colnames(d) <- paste0("d", mod, "_", stages[-1], "_minus_", stages[-p])
    d
  }
  X_slopes <- do.call(cbind, lapply(names(MAT), function(m) get_slopes(MAT[[m]], m)))

  X_mono <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(include_monotonicity)) {
    parallel_ok <- (as.integer(n_workers) > 1L) && (nrow(df) >= as.integer(parallel_threshold))
    X_mono <- do.call(cbind, lapply(names(MAT), function(m) {
      mono_mat(MAT[[m]],
        prefix = m,
        n_workers = n_workers,
        parallel_ok = parallel_ok)
    }))
  }

  X_couple <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(include_coupling)) {
    pairs <- combn(names(MAT), 2, simplify = FALSE)
    X_couple <- do.call(cbind, lapply(pairs, function(pr) {
      m1 <- pr[1]; m2 <- pr[2]
      coupling_mat(MAT[[m1]], MAT[[m2]], prefix = paste0(m1, "_", m2))
    }))
  }

  X_cont  <- cbind(X_levels, X_slopes, X_mono, X_couple)
  Xz_cont <- fast_scale(X_cont)

  if (isTRUE(inspect_feature_matrix)) {
    message("===== Feature matrix: Xz_cont (engineered; NO profiles) =====")
    message("dim: ", nrow(Xz_cont), " x ", ncol(Xz_cont))
    if (isTRUE(show_feature_names)) message("features: ", paste(colnames(Xz_cont), collapse = ", "))
    print(utils::head(Xz_cont, feature_head_n))
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 3) Anchors + unified matrix for PCA → UMAP → clustering
  # ============================================================
  anchor_mm <- NULL
  w_anchor <- 0
  X_for_pca <- Xz_cont

  if (isTRUE(use_anchors)) {
    bin_list <- lapply(names(MAT), function(m) {
      apply(MAT[[m]], 1, const_bin,
            const_range_cut = const_range_cut,
            const_sd_cut    = const_sd_cut,
            level_breaks    = level_breaks)
    })
    names(bin_list) <- names(MAT)
    anchor_mm <- do.call(cbind, lapply(names(bin_list), function(m) make_anchor_mm_4lvl(bin_list[[m]], m)))

    cont_norm   <- sqrt(rowSums(Xz_cont^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    anchor_norm <- sqrt(rowSums(anchor_mm^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    anchor_norm[!is.finite(anchor_norm) | anchor_norm == 0] <- 1

    w_anchor <- target_anchor_ratio *
      median(cont_norm, na.rm = TRUE) /
      median(anchor_norm, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(w_anchor)) w_anchor <- 0

    X_for_pca <- cbind(Xz_cont, w_anchor * anchor_mm)
    X_for_pca[!is.finite(X_for_pca)] <- 0
  }

  if (isTRUE(row_normalize_features)) {
    X_for_pca <- safe_row_normalize(X_for_pca)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 4) PCA → UMAP → Cluster in UMAP space
  # ============================================================

  # Step 4a: PCA
  set.seed(seed)
  X_use <- as.matrix(X_for_pca)
  X_use[!is.finite(X_use)] <- 0

  if (!is.null(cluster_n_pcs) && cluster_n_pcs > 1L && ncol(X_use) > 2L) {
    npc <- min(as.integer(cluster_n_pcs), ncol(X_use) - 1L)
    if (requireNamespace("irlba", quietly = TRUE)) {
      pca_emb <- irlba::prcomp_irlba(X_use,
        n = npc,
        center = TRUE,
        scale. = FALSE)$x
    } else {
      pca_emb <- stats::prcomp(X_use,
        rank. = npc,
        center = TRUE,
        scale. = FALSE)$x
    }
    message("PCA: Reduced to ", ncol(pca_emb), " dimensions for UMAP input")
  } else {
    pca_emb <- X_use
    message("PCA: Skipped (using full feature matrix for UMAP)")
  }

  # Step 4b: UMAP from PCA embedding
  set.seed(seed)
  umap_input <- as.matrix(pca_emb)
  umap_input[!is.finite(umap_input)] <- 0

  message("Computing UMAP from PCA space...")
  um <- uwot::umap(
    umap_input,
    n_neighbors = n_neighbors,
    min_dist    = min_dist,
    metric      = umap_metric,
    n_threads   = umap_threads
  )
  message("UMAP computed: ", nrow(um), " points in 2D space")

  # Step 4c: Cluster IN UMAP space (aligned)
  message("Clustering in UMAP space (ensures alignment with visualization)...")
  gc <- cluster_in_umap_space(
    um,
    k_param    = as.integer(cluster_k_param),
    snn_k      = cluster_snn_k,
    resolution = cluster_resolution,
    prune_snn  = cluster_prune_snn,
    algorithm  = cluster_algorithm,
    use_snn    = use_snn,
    seed       = seed
  )

  cl_raw <- as.integer(gc$cluster)
  cl_raw <- merge_small_clusters(um, cl_raw, min_size = as.integer(min_cluster_size))
  cl_raw <- relabel_by_size(cl_raw)
  df$three_way_cluster <- factor(cl_raw)

  message(sprintf(
    "Graph diagnostics: edges=%s | mean_degree=%.2f | isolated=%.1f%% | kNN_used=%d | space=%s",

    scales::comma(gc$diagnostics$edges),
    gc$diagnostics$mean_degree,
    100 * gc$diagnostics$frac_isolated,
    gc$diagnostics$k_nn_used,
    gc$diagnostics$space
  ))

  tab <- dplyr::count(tibble(cluster = df$three_way_cluster),
    cluster,
    name = "n") %>%
    mutate(frac = n / sum(n))

  algo_note <- paste0(
    "UMAP-aligned clustering (", cluster_algorithm,
    ", use_snn=", use_snn,
    ", k=", cluster_k_param,
    ifelse(isTRUE(use_snn), paste0(", snn_k=", gc$diagnostics$k_nn_used), ""),
    ", res=", cluster_resolution,
    ", prune=", signif(cluster_prune_snn, 3),
    ", merge<", min_cluster_size, ")"
  )

  algo_suffix <- paste0(
    "umap_aligned_",
    cluster_algorithm,
    "_k", cluster_k_param,
    ifelse(isTRUE(use_snn), paste0("_snn", gc$diagnostics$k_nn_used), "_knn"),
    "_pcs", ifelse(is.null(cluster_n_pcs), "full", cluster_n_pcs),
    "_unn", n_neighbors,
    "_res", safe_num(cluster_resolution),
    "_pr", safe_num(cluster_prune_snn),
    "_m", min_cluster_size,
    ifelse(isTRUE(use_anchors), paste0("_anch", safe_num(signif(w_anchor, 3))), "_noanch"),
    ifelse(isTRUE(include_monotonicity), "_mono", "_nomono"),
    ifelse(isTRUE(include_coupling), "_coup", "_nocoup")
  )

  message(
    "Engineered features. Profiles=OFF; Monotonicity=",
    ifelse(include_monotonicity, "ON", "OFF"),

    "; Coupling=", ifelse(include_coupling, "ON", "OFF"),
    "; Anchors=", ifelse(use_anchors, "ON", "OFF"),
    ifelse(use_anchors, paste0(" | w_anchor=", signif(w_anchor, 3)), ""),
    ifelse(row_normalize_features, " | row_norm=ON", " | row_norm=OFF"),

    " | PCA dims=", ncol(pca_emb),
    " | UMAP n_neighbors=", n_neighbors,
    " | clustering=", algo_note,
    " | K=", dplyr::n_distinct(df$three_way_cluster)
  )

  # ============================================================
  # 5) UMAP plot with clusters
  # ============================================================
  umap_df <- df %>% mutate(UMAP1 = um[, 1],
    UMAP2 = um[, 2])

  label_df <- umap_df %>%
    group_by(three_way_cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      UMAP1 = median(UMAP1, na.rm = TRUE),

      UMAP2 = median(UMAP2, na.rm = TRUE),

      n     = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(three_way_cluster,
      "\n(n=",
      n,
      ")"))

  p_umap <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = three_way_cluster)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.22,
      alpha = 0.55) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, label = label),

      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      fill  = scales::alpha("white", 0.40),
      label.size = 0.20,
      size = 3.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      seed = seed
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.5,
      alpha = 1))) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.width  = grid::unit(0.5, "cm")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Three-way chromatin programs: ATAC–AC–ME3 (engineered features; NO profiles)",
      subtitle = paste0("UMAP computed from PCA (", ncol(pca_emb), " dims). Clustering = ", algo_note, " [IN UMAP SPACE]"),

      color = "Cluster"
    )

  umap_stem <- paste0(umap_prefix, "_ATAC_AC_ME3_", algo_suffix)
  umap_pdf  <- file.path(out_plot_dir, paste0(umap_stem, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(umap_pdf,
    p_umap,
    width = umap_width,
    height = umap_height,
    units = "in",
    device = dev_fun)
  if (isTRUE(show_plots)) print(p_umap)

  # ============================================================
  # 6) Trajectory plot (ALL 3 modalities)
  # ============================================================
  vec_to_long <- function(df_in, mod) {
    mat <- matrix(unlist(df_in[[paste0(mod, "_vec")]], use.names = FALSE),
      ncol = length(stages),
      byrow = TRUE)
    colnames(mat) <- stages
    as.data.frame(mat) %>%
      mutate(row_id = seq_len(nrow(mat))) %>%
      pivot_longer(-row_id,
        names_to = "Stage",
        values_to = "quantile_value") %>%
      mutate(Modality = mod)
  }

  traj_long <- bind_rows(
    vec_to_long(umap_df, "ATAC"),
    vec_to_long(umap_df, "AC"),
    vec_to_long(umap_df, "ME3")
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      umap_df %>% transmute(row_id = dplyr::row_number(), cluster = as.character(three_way_cluster)),

      by = "row_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Stage    = factor(Stage, levels = stages),

      Modality = factor(Modality, levels = c("ATAC","AC","ME3")),

      cluster  = factor(cluster,
      levels = levels(umap_df$three_way_cluster))
    )

  cluster_n <- traj_long %>%
    distinct(row_id, cluster) %>%
    dplyr::count(cluster, name = "n")

  traj_summary <- traj_long %>%
    group_by(cluster, Modality, Stage) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_quantile = mean(quantile_value, na.rm = TRUE),

      sd_quantile   = sd(quantile_value, na.rm = TRUE),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(cluster_n, by = "cluster") %>%
    mutate(
      ymin = pmax(0, mean_quantile - sd_quantile),
      ymax = pmin(max_level, mean_quantile + sd_quantile),
      cluster_label = paste0(as.character(cluster),
      "\n(n=",
      n,
      ")")
    )

  label_levels <- traj_summary %>%
    distinct(cluster, cluster_label) %>%
    mutate(ord = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(cluster)))) %>%
    arrange(ord) %>%
    pull(cluster_label)
  traj_summary$cluster_label <- factor(traj_summary$cluster_label, levels = label_levels)

  p_traj <- ggplot(traj_summary,
    aes(Stage, mean_quantile, color = Modality, group = Modality)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = line_width) +
    geom_point(size = point_size) +
    facet_wrap(~ cluster_label, ncol = facet_ncol) +
    scale_color_manual(values = modality_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_level),
      breaks = seq(0, max_level, 2)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),

      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),

      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),

      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Developmental stage",
      y = "Mean quantized signal level (0–10)",
      color = "Modality",
      title = "Mean quantized chromatin trajectories (ATAC–AC–ME3)",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Clusters aligned with UMAP (", algo_note, ")\n",
        "Band = ±1 SD across loci within cluster"
      )
    )

  traj_stem <- paste0(traj_prefix, "_ATAC_AC_ME3_", algo_suffix)
  traj_pdf  <- file.path(out_plot_dir, paste0(traj_stem, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(traj_pdf,
    p_traj,
    width = traj_width,
    height = traj_height,
    units = "in",
    device = dev_fun)
  if (isTRUE(show_plots)) print(p_traj)

  # ============================================================
  # 7) Bundle
  # ============================================================
  bundle <- list(
    connection = "threeway_ATAC_AC_ME3",
    modalities_features = mods_feat,
    stages = stages,
    max_level = max_level,

    feature_engineering = list(
      include_monotonicity = include_monotonicity,
      include_coupling = include_coupling
    ),

    use_anchors = use_anchors,
    w_anchor = w_anchor,
    anchor_mm = anchor_mm,
    row_normalize_features = row_normalize_features,

    clustering_note = algo_note,
    algo_suffix = algo_suffix,
    min_cluster_size = as.integer(min_cluster_size),
    clustering_obj = gc,
    cluster_table = tab,

    X_cont = X_cont,
    Xz_cont = Xz_cont,
    X_for_pca = X_for_pca,
    pca_embedding = pca_emb,

    umap_coords = um,
    umap_df = umap_df,
    umap_plot = p_umap,

    traj_plot = p_traj,
    traj_summary = traj_summary,

    files = list(
      umap_pdf = umap_pdf,
      traj_pdf = traj_pdf
    ),

    params = list(
      n_neighbors = n_neighbors,
      min_dist = min_dist,
      umap_threads = umap_threads,
      umap_metric = umap_metric,
      cluster_k_param = cluster_k_param,
      cluster_snn_k = cluster_snn_k,
      cluster_n_pcs = cluster_n_pcs,
      cluster_resolution = cluster_resolution,
      cluster_prune_snn = cluster_prune_snn,
      cluster_algorithm = cluster_algorithm,
      use_snn = use_snn,
      seed = seed
    )
  )

  if (isTRUE(save_bundle)) {
    bundle_rds <- file.path(out_obj_dir, paste0(umap_stem, ".rds"))
    saveRDS(bundle, bundle_rds)
    bundle$files$bundle_rds <- bundle_rds
  }

  invisible(bundle)
}
```

## Selected pairwise and three-way analysis calls

These calls retain the selected high- and low-resolution configurations stored in the final eight bundles. Generic function defaults are not the manuscript settings. Cluster IDs are specific to a bundle; manual program labels must not be transferred to a different clustering by numeric ID alone.

```{r integration-selected-calls, eval=isTRUE(params$run_integration)}
bundles_recomputed <- list()
for (connection in c("atac_ac", "atac_me3", "ac_me3")) {
  for (resolution in c("low", "high")) {
    high <- resolution == "high"
    key <- paste(connection, resolution, sep = "_")
    bundles_recomputed[[key]] <- run_pairwise_recluster_and_plots(
      traj_df = traj_df,
      connection = connection,
      cluster_n_pcs = 15,
      n_neighbors = 200,

      min_dist = 0.2,
      cluster_k_param = 2500,
      cluster_resolution = if (high)
        0.05 else 0.03, cluster_prune_snn = if (high)
        0 else 0.05, min_cluster_size = if (high)
        300 else 500,
        use_snn = TRUE,
        cluster_algorithm = "leiden",
        include_all_modalities = FALSE,

      seed = 42,
      show_plots = FALSE
    )
  }
}
for (resolution in c("low", "high")) {
  high <- resolution == "high"
  bundles_recomputed[[paste0("threeway_", resolution)]] <- run_threeway_recluster_and_plots(
    traj_df = traj_df,
    cluster_n_pcs = 15,
    n_neighbors = 200,
    min_dist = 0.2,

    cluster_k_param = 2500,
    cluster_snn_k = if (high)
      500 else 800, cluster_resolution = if (high)
      0.03 else 0.01,
      cluster_prune_snn = 0,
      min_cluster_size = 500,
      use_snn = TRUE,

    cluster_algorithm = "leiden",
    seed = 42,
    show_plots = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Manual biological program definitions

The original manual cluster-to-program definitions are included verbatim. This section uses the final catalog’s saved bundle-specific cluster columns. After a new clustering, match and validate clusters before reusing the manual labels.

```{r integration-manual-programs, eval=isTRUE(params$run_integration)}
all_overlaps_aug <- all_overlaps_total
program_defs_threeway_high_res <- list(
  "1a. VZ/SVZ decommissioning with repression" = c(6, 16, 28),
  "1d. Activation and derepression of SVZ pREs" = c(11, 26, 36),
  "1f. Repression-dominant" = c(4),

  "2a. Activation with derepression" = c(8, 21, 34, 39),
  "2b. Derepression-led activation" = c(20, 29, 35),

  "3a. Progressive activation with derepression" = c(1, 3, 12, 18, 27),
  "3b. Repression of embryonic cell fates" = c(7, 17, 24, 25),

  "4a. Constitutively active" = c(10, 19, 37, 38),
  "4b. Constitutively active / bivalent" = c(5, 13, 32, 33)
)

program_defs_atac_ac_high_res <- list(
  "1b. H3K27me3-independent decommissioning" = c(1, 3, 20, 25, 26, 28, 29, 32, 33, 37, 39),
  "1e. Transient activation of SVZ pREs (H3K27me3 independent)" = c(2, 5, 10, 35),

  "2c. Progressive activation (H3K27me3-independent)" = c(9, 11, 12, 13, 16, 22, 30, 44),

  "3c. Progressive activation (H3K27me3-independent)" = c(14, 15, 24, 34, 40, 42, 43),

  "4c. ATAC-H3K27ac constitutive" = c(17, 18, 21, 36, 38, 41)
)

program_defs_atac_me3_low_res <- list(
  "1c. Progressive repression" = c(3, 4),
  "2d. ATAC/H3K27me3 derepression" = c(6),
  "4d. Progressive derepression (non-cortical brain pREs?)" = c(2)
)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Helper: defs -> lookup (cluster_id -> program_name)
# -----------------------------
defs_to_lookup <- function(defs) {
  data.frame(
    cluster_id = as.integer(unlist(defs, use.names = FALSE)),

    program = rep(names(defs), times = vapply(defs, length, integer(1))),

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

lk_3way   <- defs_to_lookup(program_defs_threeway_high_res)
lk_aa     <- defs_to_lookup(program_defs_atac_ac_high_res)
lk_am_low <- defs_to_lookup(program_defs_atac_me3_low_res)

stopifnot(!any(duplicated(lk_3way$cluster_id)))
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(lk_aa$cluster_id)))
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(lk_am_low$cluster_id)))

map_3way   <- setNames(lk_3way$program, as.character(lk_3way$cluster_id))
map_aa     <- setNames(lk_aa$program, as.character(lk_aa$cluster_id))
map_am_low <- setNames(lk_am_low$program, as.character(lk_am_low$cluster_id))

# -----------------------------
# 3) Assign Program (no Program_source)
# -----------------------------
all_overlaps_aug$Program <- NA_character_

# Three-way rows
if ("THREEWAY_high_res_prog_cl" %in% names(all_overlaps_aug)) {
  idx <- which(
    all_overlaps_aug$overlap_type == "three_way" &
      !is.na(all_overlaps_aug$THREEWAY_high_res_prog_cl)
  )
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    cl <- as.character(all_overlaps_aug$THREEWAY_high_res_prog_cl[idx])
    all_overlaps_aug$Program[idx] <- unname(map_3way[cl])
  }
}

# ATAC-AC rows
if ("ATAC_AC_high_res_prog_cl" %in% names(all_overlaps_aug)) {
  idx <- which(
    all_overlaps_aug$overlap_type == "atac_ac" &
      !is.na(all_overlaps_aug$ATAC_AC_high_res_prog_cl)
  )
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    cl <- as.character(all_overlaps_aug$ATAC_AC_high_res_prog_cl[idx])
    all_overlaps_aug$Program[idx] <- unname(map_aa[cl])
  }
}

# ATAC-ME3 rows (low-res)
if ("ATAC_ME3_low_res_prog_cl" %in% names(all_overlaps_aug)) {
  idx <- which(
    all_overlaps_aug$overlap_type == "atac_me3" &
      !is.na(all_overlaps_aug$ATAC_ME3_low_res_prog_cl)
  )
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    cl <- as.character(all_overlaps_aug$ATAC_ME3_low_res_prog_cl[idx])
    all_overlaps_aug$Program[idx] <- unname(map_am_low[cl])
  }
}
```


## Load the original clustering bundles without refitting

The saved checkpoint contains the eight selected pairwise/three-way resolution variants, their configurations, embeddings, cluster assignments and feature matrices. Loading it does not refit a model. It is optional because the object occupies approximately 571 MB on disk; the standard panel export uses the compact plotting tables.

```{r integration-load-native-bundles, eval=isTRUE(params$load_native_bundles)}
checkpoint_environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
load(
  file.path(REPO, "objects", "integration", "umap_reclustering_bundles.RData"),
  envir = checkpoint_environment
)
native_bundles <- checkpoint_environment$bundles
stopifnot(
  length(native_bundles) == 8
)
native_parameters <- lapply(native_bundles, function(bundle) bundle$params)
native_parameters
```
