## Dynamic network from the original draft

The original module-size, overlap-count, tier and seed rules are retained. This uses the saved overlap catalog, without rebuilding overlaps or networks.

```{r figure-4-draft-dynamic-network}
all_overlaps <- read.csv(file.path(REPO, "data/upstream/integration/all_overlaps_total_aug_with_Programs.csv"))
## Hairball plot: dynamic modules only (no constitutive)
## INPUT: all_overlaps with ATAC_FC, AC_FC, ME3_FC

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(ggrepel)

## 1) tunables --------------------------------------------------------------
min_connections <- 200   # <- updated
min_module_size <- 1000  # <- keep from previous step
allow_jitter <- TRUE
jitter_x <- 0.1
jitter_y <- 0.06

## 2) dataset-specific tier maps -------------------------------------------
atac_tiers <- list(
  Early = c("turquoise","tan","cyan"),
  Intermediate = c("salmon","midnightblue","green","red",
                   "Weak_middle","brown","yellow","magenta"),
  Late = c("blue","Weak_late","purple","P2_specific"),
  Constitutive = c("Constitutive_strong","Constitutive_weak",
                   "lightcyan","greenyellow","black","pink","grey")
)
ac_tiers <- list(
  Early = c("Weak_early_VZ","turquoise","Weak_VZ","Weak_late_VZ","brown"),
  Intermediate = c("lightgreen","black","pink","blue","tan","green","cyan",
                   "royalblue","darkred","salmon","magenta","lightyellow",
                   "midnightblue","purple"),
  Late = c("yellow","red","Strong_late_1","Strong_late_2"),
  Constitutive = c("Constitutive_strong_1","Constitutive_strong_2",
                   "greenyellow","lightcyan","grey60","Grey","grey")
)
me3_tiers <- list(
  Early = c("green","darkorange","red","greenyellow","white","salmon","brown"),
  Intermediate = c("yellow","midnightblue","darkturquoise","steelblue","grey60",
                   "purple","pink","magenta","black","lightcyan","lightgreen",
                   "orange","tan","cyan","royalblue","skyblue","darkgreen",
                   "darkgrey","saddlebrown"),
  Late = c("blue","turquoise","Weak_late"),
  Constitutive = c("Constitutive_medium","Constitutive_strong",
                   "Constitutive_weak","grey")
)

get_tier <- function(ds, mod) {
  if (is.na(ds) || is.na(mod)) return("Constitutive")
  src <- switch(ds,
                ATAC = atac_tiers,
                AC   = ac_tiers,
                ME3  = me3_tiers,
                NULL)
  if (is.null(src)) return("Constitutive")
  for (nm in names(src)) if (mod %in% src[[nm]]) return(nm)
  "Constitutive"
}

## 3) module sizes ----------------------------------------------------------
mod_sizes <- all_overlaps %>%
  select(ATAC_FC, AC_FC, ME3_FC) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "ds", values_to = "Module") %>%
  separate(ds, into = c("Dataset","drop"), sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>%
  count(Dataset, Module, name = "mod_n")

## 4) edges (all three dataset pairs) --------------------------------------
edges_long <- all_overlaps %>%
  transmute(
    pair1 = paste0("ATAC_", ATAC_FC, "||AC_",  AC_FC),
    pair2 = paste0("ATAC_", ATAC_FC, "||ME3_", ME3_FC),
    pair3 = paste0("AC_",   AC_FC,   "||ME3_", ME3_FC)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), values_to = "pair") %>%
  separate(pair, c("source","target"), sep = "\\|\\|")

edges <- edges_long %>%
  count(source, target, name = "weight") %>%
  filter(weight >= min_connections)

## 5) node table ------------------------------------------------------------
nodes <- tibble(node_id = unique(c(edges$source, edges$target))) %>%
  mutate(
    Dataset = case_when(
      str_starts(node_id, "ATAC_") ~ "ATAC",
      str_starts(node_id, "AC_")   ~ "AC",
      str_starts(node_id, "ME3_")  ~ "ME3",
      TRUE                         ~ "other"
    ),
    Module = str_remove(node_id, "^(ATAC_|AC_|ME3_)")
  ) %>%
  left_join(mod_sizes, by = c("Dataset","Module")) %>%
  mutate(mod_n = tidyr::replace_na(mod_n, 0L)) %>%
  filter(mod_n >= min_module_size)

## 6) drop edges to removed nodes -------------------------------------------
edges <- edges %>%
  semi_join(nodes, by = c("source" = "node_id")) %>%
  semi_join(nodes, by = c("target" = "node_id"))

## 7) assign tiers (flip ME3 Early↔Late for layout) ------------------------
nodes <- nodes %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(BioTier = get_tier(Dataset, Module)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    LayoutTier = dplyr::case_when(
      Dataset == "ME3" & BioTier == "Early" ~ "Late",
      Dataset == "ME3" & BioTier == "Late"  ~ "Early",
      TRUE                                  ~ BioTier
    )
  )

## 8) KEEP ONLY dynamic tiers (Early, Intermediate, Late) -------------------
nodes_dyn <- nodes %>%
  filter(LayoutTier %in% c("Early","Intermediate","Late"))

edges_dyn <- edges %>%
  filter(source %in% nodes_dyn$node_id & target %in% nodes_dyn$node_id)

## 9) layout for dynamic-only ----------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)

top_layout_map <- tibble(
  LayoutTier = c("Early", "Intermediate", "Late"),
  x_center   = c(0.17,    0.50,           0.83),
  x_min      = c(0.00,    0.34,           0.67),
  x_max      = c(0.33,    0.66,           1.00)
)

dataset_y_top <- c(ATAC = 0.95, AC = 0.78, ME3 = 0.61)
vert_span     <- 0.14

nodes_layout <- nodes_dyn %>%
  left_join(top_layout_map, by = "LayoutTier") %>%
  arrange(LayoutTier, Dataset, Module) %>%
  group_by(LayoutTier, Dataset) %>%
  mutate(
    jx = if (allow_jitter) runif(n(), -jitter_x, jitter_x) else 0,
    x  = pmax(x_min + 0.01, pmin(x_max - 0.01, x_center + jx)),
    y  = {
      y0 <- dataset_y_top[[as.character(dplyr::first(Dataset))]]
      if (n() == 1L) y0 else y0 - (row_number() - 1) * (vert_span / (n() - 1))
    },
    BoxID = dplyr::case_when(
      LayoutTier == "Early"        ~ 1L,
      LayoutTier == "Intermediate" ~ 2L,
      LayoutTier == "Late"         ~ 3L,
      TRUE                         ~ 99L
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(name = node_id)

## 10) edges with colors (drop Early–Late entirely) ------------------------
edges_plot <- edges_dyn %>%
  left_join(nodes_layout %>% select(name, x, y, BoxID),
            by = c("source" = "name")) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y, box_start = BoxID) %>%
  left_join(nodes_layout %>% select(name, x, y, BoxID),
            by = c("target" = "name")) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y, box_end = BoxID) %>%
  filter(!(box_start %in% 1:3 & box_end %in% 1:3 & abs(box_start - box_end) == 2)) %>%
  mutate(
    edge_col = dplyr::case_when(
      box_start == box_end ~ "#51449A",
      box_start %in% 1:3 & box_end %in% 1:3 & abs(box_start - box_end) == 1 ~ "#3695CB",
      TRUE ~ "grey65"
    )
  )

dictionary <- read.csv(file.path(REPO, "data/upstream/Module_renaming_dictionary.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
stopifnot("Data_type" %in% names(dictionary))
lookup <- setNames(dictionary$Module_figure_names_short, paste(dictionary$Data_type, dictionary$Fine_clusters))
nodes_layout$Display <- unname(lookup[paste(nodes_layout$Dataset, nodes_layout$Module)])
nodes_layout$Display[is.na(nodes_layout$Display)] <- nodes_layout$Module[is.na(nodes_layout$Display)]

## 11) scales / labels ------------------------------------------------------
edge_breaks <- sort(unique(c(min_connections,
                             min_connections * 2,
                             min_connections * 4)))
edge_breaks <- edge_breaks[edge_breaks <= max(edges_plot$weight, na.rm = TRUE)]

plot_title <- paste0("High-confidence inter-dataset links (dynamic only, ≥", min_connections, " overlaps)")
plot_subtitle <- paste0("Early / Intermediate / Late (stretched); ME3 Early↔Late swap; nodes shown if n ≥ ", min_module_size)

## 12) plot -----------------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.00, xmax = 0.33, ymin = 0.40, ymax = 1.00,
           fill = "#dcecf7", alpha = 0.35) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.34, xmax = 0.66, ymin = 0.40, ymax = 1.00,
           fill = "#f6eddc", alpha = 0.35) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.67, xmax = 1.00, ymin = 0.40, ymax = 1.00,
           fill = "#f3dce4", alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0.00, xmax = 0.33, ymin = 0.40, ymax = 1.00),
            fill = NA, colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0.34, xmax = 0.66, ymin = 0.40, ymax = 1.00),
            fill = NA, colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0.67, xmax = 1.00, ymin = 0.40, ymax = 1.00),
            fill = NA, colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.99, label = "Early",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.35, y = 0.99, label = "Intermediate",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.68, y = 0.99, label = "Late",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges_plot,
    aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end, size = weight),
    colour = edges_plot$edge_col,
    alpha  = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range  = c(0.6, 3.4),
    breaks = edge_breaks,
    name   = "overlaps"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = nodes_layout,
    aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Dataset),
    size = 4, stroke = 0.7
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = nodes_layout,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = Display, fill = BioTier),
    size = 4,
    colour = "#444444",
    label.size = 0,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.25,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    segment.size = 0.25,
    segment.alpha = 0.8,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(ATAC = "#777777", AC = "#777777", ME3 = "#2DA64A"),
    name   = "Dataset origin"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Early = "#FFE100", Intermediate = "#7DD0E6", Late = "#FF7566"), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0.40, 1.00)) +
  labs(
    title    = "High-confidence interdataset links (dynamic)",
    subtitle = NULL,
    x = NULL, y = NULL

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),

p
```

## Readable program cards from saved assignments

Pool the original quantized vectors with the original cluster lists. This computes descriptive means only, without clustering or model fitting. Source program 2d is displayed as 3d to follow the manuscript arrangement.

```{r figure-4-readable-program-cards}
source("R/program_summary_saved.R")
prog_df$Key <- sub("\\..*", "", as.character(prog_df$Program))
counts <- read_table("Fig4_KC", "4f_Program_counts")
counts$Key <- sub("\\..*", "", counts$Program)
keys <- c("1a", "1b", "1c", "1d", "1e", "2a", "2b", "2c", "3a", "3b", "3c", "2d", "4a", "4b")
cards <- lapply(keys, function(key) {
  z <- prog_df[prog_df$Key == key, ]
  stopifnot(nrow(z) > 0)
  count <- counts[!is.na(counts$Key) & counts$Key == key, ]
  stopifnot(nrow(count) == 1)
  title <- sub("\\n.*", "", as.character(z$Program[1]))
  if (key == "2d") title <- sub("^2d", "3d", title)
  title <- paste(strwrap(title, width = 29), collapse = "\n")
  z$Stage <- factor(z$Stage, levels = stages)
  strip <- data.frame(Stage = factor(stages, levels = stages), y = -0.8)
  ggplot(z, aes(Stage, mean_quantized, color = Modality, group = Modality)) +
    geom_tile(data = strip, aes(Stage, y, fill = Stage), inherit.aes = FALSE, height = 0.8, width = 1) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.45) + geom_point(size = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(ATAC = "#545454", AC = "#58B947", ME3 = "#FF3D2E")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = MS$cell) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 5, 10)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1.2, 10.4), clip = "off") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = sprintf("n=%d; %.2f%%", count$Count, count$Percent), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", lineheight = 0.95),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3))
})
names(cards) <- keys
header <- function(text) ggplot() + annotate("text", 0, 0, label = text, hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  xlim(0, 1) + theme_void() + theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", color = NA))
legend <- ggplot(data.frame(Modality = c("ATAC", "AC", "ME3"), x = 1, y = 3:1), aes(x, y, color = Modality)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + geom_text(aes(label = c("ATAC", "H3K27ac", "H3K27me3")), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(ATAC = "#545454", AC = "#58B947", ME3 = "#FF3D2E")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.9, 2), ylim = c(0, 4)) + theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none")
g1 <- (cards[["1a"]] | cards[["1b"]] | legend) / (cards[["1c"]] | cards[["1d"]] | cards[["1e"]])
g2 <- cards[["2a"]] | cards[["2b"]] | cards[["2c"]]
g34 <- (cards[["3a"]] | cards[["3b"]] | cards[["4a"]]) / (cards[["3c"]] | cards[["2d"]] | cards[["4b"]])
p <- header("1. Progenitor (VZ/SVZ) programs") / g1 /
  header("2. Prenatal neuronal (ImN) programs") / g2 /
  header("3. Postnatal neuronal programs       4. Constitutive") / g34 +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.22, 2, 0.22, 1, 0.22, 2))
export_panel(p, "Fig4/4f_readable_programs", 5.7, 8.5)
write.csv(prog_df, file.path(REPO, "data/upstream/integration/program_summary_saved.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
